title: IAM Operations Manager
description:
**Job Summary**
 Responsible for leading the organization’s cybersecurity operations team, with a primary focus on incident response, threat monitoring, and the execution of cybersecurity strategies, policies, and risk management practices to safeguard the organization’s systems, data, and infrastructure. The manager serves as a coach and mentor to security professionals, builds operational processes aligned with best practices and industry standards, and partners with engineering, IT, and business to protect critical systems, infrastructure, and data from evolving threats. Serves as an accountable leader for the people, processes, and technologies that prevent, detect, investigate, and contain cyber threats across enterprise, cloud, and OT environments. Owns SecOps outcomes (24×7 monitoring \& incident response), the detection engineering program (use\-case lifecycle, signal quality, automation), and the threat hunting program
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 Leads the execution of complex responses to computer security incidents in alignment with organizational policies and industry best practices. Coordinates and communicates with multiple business units during incidents, providing updates and actionable recommendations. Oversees root cause analysis and ensures that lessons learned are integrated into improved processes and protections. Leads teams in assessing severity, developing mitigation strategies, and prioritizing risk reduction activities. Monitors security\-related intelligence sources (e.g., SANS, BugTraq) to maintain situational awareness of current attacks and trends. Collaborates with Cybersecurity Engineering teams and business to communicate risks and recommend security enhancements. Ensures that security technologies employed by the operations and incident response teams support and enhance operational processes. Identifies opportunities to improve operational efficiency, standard operating procedures, and incident response playbooks. Leads the application of recognized cybersecurity and IT frameworks (e.g., NIST, ISO, ITIL, COBIT) in alignment with organizational processes and controls. Manages, coaches, and mentors cybersecurity operations staff, fostering a culture of learning, accountability, and continuous improvement. Defines team objectives, evaluates performance, and supports professional growth through training and development. Participates in industry task forces and working groups to stay informed on evolving threats and best practices, and fosters a culture of continuous improvement in cybersecurity practices and awareness. Contributes to organizational situational awareness by managing and leveraging cybersecurity data sources.
   

  

 Competencies: Process Management and Optimization \- Designs, refines, and automates IT operations processes to improve efficiency, consistency, service quality, security, and cost effectiveness across diverse environments.
   

  

 Service Quality and Reliability \- Ensures IT services consistently meet performance, availability, and user satisfaction expectations by proactively maintaining service integrity, minimizing disruptions, and driving continuous improvement through collaboration, cost\-effective practices, and operational excellence.
   

  

 Risk Management \- Proactively identifies, assesses, and mitigates risks to IT services, data, and operations by applying structured controls and communication strategies to strengthen resilience, ensure compliance, and reduce business impact through structured controls, cost\-aware decision\-making, and communication strategies.
   

  

 Incident and Problem Management \- Responds to disruptions and recurring issues by restoring service quickly, identifying root causes, and applying structured methods to reduce risk, improve reliability, and prevent recurrence.
   

  

 Standardization and Documentation \- Creates and maintains clear, accessible documentation and standardized procedures to ensure consistent practices, traceability, and knowledge sharing across IT environments.
   

  

 Technical Passion and Drive \- Models curiosity and excitement for technology by self\-initiating continuous development, experimenting with emerging technologies, and identifying insertion opportunities that accelerate business performance.
   

  

 Security and Compliance \- Applies standards, tools, and best practices to embed security, privacy, and compliance into the design/build/test/operate lifecycle for products, services, apps, systems, software, and configurations—balancing protection, efficiency, and cost.
   

  

 Driving Effective Outcomes \- Takes ownership, acts with urgency, and initiates action to turn goals into clear plans, decisions, guardrails, and cadences while navigating ambiguity and change to drive momentum and deliver consistent results.
   

  

 Engaging with Impact \- Communicates with clarity and purpose to align stakeholders, foster collaboration, build trust, and influence coordinated action across teams and functions to accelerate outcomes.
   

  

 Values Differences \- Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.
   

  

 Ensuring Customer Success \- Embraces a customer\-first mindset to deliver outcomes by linking customer needs and business priorities to aligned solutions, delivery, adoption, satisfaction, and realized value through sustained engagement that builds partnership and trust.
   

  

 Managing People and Teams \- Builds inclusive teams that empower ownership, deepen capabilities, and ensure fair, timely performance accountability, creating an environment where people can deliver their best work and top performance.
   

  

 Directs Work \- Creates conditions for team success with clear goals, priorities, work plans, standards, effective processes, resourcing, and governance to enable fast, empowered, accountable, and quality execution.
   

  

 Education, Licenses, Certifications: College, university, or equivalent degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related subject, or relevant equivalent experience required. Global Information Assurance Certification (GIAC) Security Essentials Certification, GIAC Security Leadership Certification, Information Systems Audit and Control Association (ISACA) Certified Information Security Manager, Microsoft Certified Systems Engineer: Security, or Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP) certification preferred. This position may require licensing for compliance with export controls or sanctions regulations.
   

  

 Experience: Understanding of the capabilities and configuration of industrial cybersecurity controls and solutions across multiple facets; for example: asset management, vulnerability management, anomaly detection, identity and access management, network security, endpoint security, application security, IDS/IPS, deep packet inspection, SIEM, data analytics, security and/or risk management and product development.
   

  

 Demonstrated ability to lead teams, manage budgets, and build organizational capability.
   

  

 Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence policy and advocate for cybersecurity best practices.
   

  

 Proven experience in cybersecurity management or equivalent leadership role.
   

  

**Primary Function** 
 : The IAM Operations Manager is responsible for leading the organization’s IAM operations team across all IAM functions, with a primary focus on incident and problem response, general administration, monitoring, system availability, and compliance tasks. This role will also be responsible for execution of IAM strategies, policies, and risk management practices to safeguard the organization’s systems, data, and infrastructure. Key duties include managing team workflows, enforcing service\-level agreements, and running security tools like Saviynt, MS Entra, CyberArk etc.
   

  

**Core Responsibilities**
* Manage ongoing IAM operations and lead internal and multiple supplier teams in assessing severity, developing mitigation strategies, and prioritizing risk reduction activities
* Oversee maintenance and specific problem resolution. Anticipate, identify, track and resolve technical issues. Oversee delivery assurance, quality, and architectural governance
* Coordinate and communicate with multiple business units and various stakeholders at all levels during incidents. Provide updates and actionable recommendations
* Oversee root cause analysis and ensure that lessons learned are integrated into improved processes and protection
* Identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency, standard operating procedures, and incident response playbooks. Create and maintain clear, accessible documentation and standardized procedures to ensure consistent practices, traceability, and knowledge sharing across IAM functions
* Establish policies for Privileged Access Management (PAM), Identity Governance and Administration (IGA), and Access Management (AM).
* Integrate IAM solutions with enterprise applications, cloud platforms, and hybrid IT infrastructures
* Collaborate with stakeholders and business leaders to translate identity requirements into scalable, compliant solutions that are clearly understood
* Work across functions to improve IAM solutions to enhance compliance requirements and best practices
* Manage, coach, and mentor IAM operations staff, fostering a culture of learning, accountability, and continuous improvement
* Define team objectives, evaluate performance, and support professional growth through training and development
* Conduct industry and market research and maintain a working knowledge of technologies and emerging trends in the IAM space

title: Mgr. Tax Data Filing
description:
**Why UKG**
 At UKG, the work you do matters. The code you ship, the decisions you make, and the care you show a customer all add up to real impact. Today, tens of millions of workers start and end their days with our workforce operating platform. Helping people get paid, grow in their careers, and shape the future of their industries. That’s what we do.
   

  

 We never stop learning. We never stop challenging the norm. We push for better, and we celebrate the wins along the way. Here, you’ll get flexibility that’s real, benefits you can count on, and a team that succeeds together. Because at UKG, your work matters—and so do you.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 UKG is seeking a customer\-focused and experienced leader to manage the Tax Filing and Amendments function within Payment Services, Managed Services. This role leads day\-to\-day production delivery, people development, operational controls, and cross\-functional issue resolution to ensure payroll tax filings and amendments are completed accurately, timely, and with clear documentation.
   

  

 The Manager is accountable for building a high\-performing team, strengthening service quality, managing risk, and driving scalable process and technology improvements. The role requires strong judgment, payroll tax domain knowledge, operational discipline, and the ability to lead through peak filing cycles, customer escalations, agency dependencies, and complex compliance scenarios and customer satisfaction.
   

  

 Role Complexity and Business Impact
   

  

* Owns a compliance\-sensitive operation where filing accuracy, amendment timeliness, documentation quality, and agency responses can directly impact customer experience, penalties, interest, and liability exposure.
* Manages a high\-volume production environment with quarter\-end, year\-end, amended return, reconciliation, notice, and escalation dependencies across federal, state, and local jurisdictions.
* Balances daily execution with continuous improvement, including quality controls, root\-cause analysis, knowledge management, automation opportunities, and scalable operating practices.
* Partners with Tax Filing, Tax Research, Payments, Product, Customer Support, technology teams, agencies, and senior leaders to resolve systemic issues and improve operational outcomes.
* Leads managers, team leads, or senior specialists where applicable, and is expected to strengthen leadership capability, accountability, and readiness across the team.


 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 People Leadership and Team Development
   

  

* Lead, coach, and develop a team responsible for tax filing, amendment processing, reconciliations, case management, and compliance support.
* Conduct regular one\-on\-ones, performance discussions, development planning, recognition, and skill\-building interventions.
* Build leadership depth by mentoring team leads or senior specialists and creating clear ownership for production, quality, training, and escalations.
* Hire, onboard, manage performance, and support engagement and retention in alignment with UKG people practices.


 Operational Delivery and Controls
   

  

* Own daily, monthly, quarterly, and annual production readiness for tax filings and amendments, ensuring timely completion, accuracy, and complete documentation.
* Manage workload allocation, queue health, staffing coverage, turnaround time, case aging, productivity, quality, and SLA adherence.
* Implement quality controls and audit\-ready documentation standards that support internal review, agency responses, and customer communication.
* Provide backup leadership coverage and support after\-hours or peak\-cycle needs when business\-critical deadlines require it.


 Tax Filing, Amendments, and Compliance Oversight
   

  

* Oversee amended return workflows, filing corrections, reconciliations, rejected filings, agency notices, tax variance analysis, and customer\-impacting tax issues.
* Ensure issues are researched end to end, supported by clear evidence, and resolved with appropriate communication to customers, agencies, and internal partners.
* Guide teams through complex multi\-jurisdiction scenarios involving federal, state, local, SUI, SIT, and related payroll tax requirements.
* Escalate high\-risk service, compliance, or customer\-impacting issues to senior leadership with facts, impact, recommended path, and ownership.


 Stakeholder, Customer, and Cross\-Functional Management
   

  

* Build strong relationships with internal partners across Payment Services, Tax Research, Product, Technology, Customer Support, and senior leadership.
* Represent the function in customer, agency, and internal escalation discussions when leadership judgment or service recovery is required.
* Communicate operational status, risks, trends, decisions, and action plans in a clear, concise, and data\-backed manner.
* Drive high customer satisfaction by providing desired resolutions on the requests.
* Partner with peers to align processes, reduce handoff gaps, and improve consistency across Managed Services tax operations.


 Process Excellence, Reporting, and Transformation

title: Community Lead (Managed Office)
description:
**About Us**
 Launched in 2017, WeWork India is one of India’s leading premium flexible workspace operators \- GPTW certified (Nov 2024 – Nov 2025, Dec 2025 – Dec 2026\). WeWork India has been the largest operator by total revenue for the past three fiscal years. Since its inception, WeWork India has expanded across 8 cities in Chennai, New Delhi, Gurugram, Noida, Mumbai, Bengaluru, Pune, and Hyderabad, with 76 operational centres spanning 8\.2 million square feet (as of December 2025\).
   

  

 WeWork India has played a significant role in the growth of the flexible workspace sector and contributed to the evolution of its products and services, providing customized and curated solutions for various office space needs.
   

  

 For more information, please visit our website.
   

  

**About Job**
 As a Lead for our Managed Offices, you will own the end\-to\-end client, operational and commercial experience for a portfolio of Managed Office clients. You will lead seamless onboarding and operational handovers, strengthen client and member relationships, drive workplace experience and engagement, identify revenue opportunities, and ensure operational, financial and compliance standards are met.
   

  

 This role works closely with Sales, Projects, Operations, Client Solutions, Finance, Community and Events teams, and provides leadership to the Community Manager / MO POD where applicable, ensuring consistent delivery and continuous improvement across the portfolio.
   

  

**Skills \& Qualification**
* Bachelor’s degree in hospitality, business administration, marketing, operations, or a related field.
* 5–8\+ years of experience in hospitality, co\-working, managed offices, workplace experience, operations, account management or customer\-facing roles; experience leading teams or portfolios is preferred.
* Strong client management, stakeholder management and commercial acumen.
* Demonstrated ability to manage cross\-functional projects, operational escalations and complex client requirements.
* Strong understanding of P\&L, billing, budgeting, revenue generation and business performance.
* Excellent verbal and written communication, presentation and negotiation skills.
* Strong analytical, organisational and problem\-solving abilities with attention to detail.
* Proficient in digital tools for ticketing, reporting, dashboards, communication and business reviews.
* A proactive, accountable and collaborative leader who can balance customer experience, operational excellence, people leadership and business outcomes. A passion for workplace experience, community.


**Responsibilities**
* Onboarding \& Transition Leadership
* Own the Managed Office onboarding and transition experience from pre\-move\-in through operational handover.
* Drive cross\-functional coordination with Sales, Projects and Operations to ensure a seamless client handover and readiness.
* Ensure 100% completion of the Building Opening Checklist within stipulated timelines.
* Coordinate with Operations and Client Solutions teams to identify, track and close post\-move\-in snags within agreed timelines, including closure of critical snags within 60 days.
* Use move\-in feedback and internal stakeholder feedback to improve onboarding and handover processes.
* Account Management \& Member Experience
* Own relationships with client SPOCs and key stakeholders, acting as the escalation point for Managed Office accounts.
* Drive exceptional day\-to\-day workplace experience while balancing member experience and facilities management.
* Plan and execute quarterly engagement activities for all Managed Office clients and measure outcomes through client/member feedback.
* Drive an average MO NPS of 75 or above across the portfolio.
* Conduct quarterly community and operations audits for Managed Offices and PCI, maintaining a minimum compliance score of 90%.
* Proactively identify service gaps, trends and opportunities to improve client satisfaction and retention.
* Operations, Compliance \& Service Delivery
* Ensure spaces remain operationally ready, well maintained and aligned to WeWork standards through structured reviews and audits.
* Own operational dashboards, ticketing, issue resolution, walkthroughs, audits and service reviews for the portfolio.
* Establish clear ownership and escalation mechanisms across Community, Operations, Projects, Finance and other internal teams.
* Ensure timely closure and communication of operational issues and client commitments.
* Drive standardisation and continuous improvement of operating processes, ROEs and SOPs.
* Revenue \& Commercial Management
* Own upsell and additional revenue opportunities across events, F\&B, community support, technology, parking, customisation and other services.
* Ensure Workplace Experience services are positioned and pitched to all relevant clients.
* Partner with Sales and internal teams to convert client needs intovalue\-added solutions and commercial opportunities.
* Own billing, P\&L and topline audit management for the Managed Office portfolio, including invoice review, budget finalisation and post\-sales P\&L management.
* Work in tandem with the BOB owner from the MO/GCC teams to ensure financial accuracy, visibility and performance.
* Team Leadership \& Capability Building
* Lead, coach and develop the MO Community / CM POD, including hiring, role design, performance management and growth planning for client\-billed headcount.
* Drive team engagement and wellbeing, with a focus on building a high\-performing and collaborative culture.
* Own team learning and development through LMS completion, endorsements, training and a quarterly L\&D calendar.
* Conduct quarterly IDP progress checks and reporting for the team.
* Build capability within the team to independently manage client relationships, workplace experience, events and operational delivery.
* Innovation, Workplace Experience \& Strategic Initiatives
* Drive continuous improvement through ROE/SOP 2\.0 and other process innovation initiatives.
* Create and develop an Event Management capability/wing to enable the team to drive events independently.
* Explore CXO/networking opportunities that strengthen client relationships and workplace experience.
* Develop PR\-as\-a\-service opportunities, including media time, interviews and podcasts, where relevant to clients and the business.
* Use client and operational insights to identify scalable solutions that improve experience and contribute to the bottom line.
* Communication, Reporting \& Stakeholder Management
* Provide structured portfolio updates covering client experience, operations, revenue, P\&L, risks, compliance and key actions.
* Maintain strong communication across Sales, Projects, Operations,
* Client Solutions, Finance, Community and Events teams.
* Present business reviews and insights to senior stakeholders and clients as required.
* Ensure timely escalation of risks, service issues and commercial opportunities.

 WeWork India is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for our employees and members. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.
   

  

 We expect all employees to embody our values and all aspects of employment including the decisions to hire and promote, are based on merit, competence, performance and business needs.
   

  

 Our total rewards philosophy is aimed at providing compensation that is competitive, performance linked and helps us attract and retain the talent we need to drive our business forward and serve our members. As part of WeWork India, our commitment to you is that you’ll be surrounded by career opportunities in a culture that fosters collaboration, flexibility and inclusion.

description:
****Responsibilities****

title: Manager, AI/HPC Infrastructure Technical Delivery — India
description:
Are you a technically seasoned leader with a passion for driving excellence in AI, HPC, and data center infrastructure delivery? Do you thrive in leading technical teams to build and deploy some of the world’s largest and fastest AI/HPC systems across the India region? At NVIDIA, we are revolutionizing deep learning, data analytics, and data center capabilities, and we are seeking a Senior Technical Delivery Manager (People Manager) to oversee a team of technical specialists—with end\-to\-end technical control over Ethernet, InfiniBand, HPC, and AI cluster delivery across APAC. This role requires a strong technical background in NVIDIA DC products (Networking, InfiniBand, AI orchestration tools), full\-stack data center technologies (storage, server, networking, virtualization, GPU), and deep understanding of AI technology, paired with proven people management skills to lead a team of a few to dozens of technical professionals. Additionally, you are expected to have a solid grasp of the the region's business model, as well as experience engaging with the customers closely.
   

  

 As a key leader in NVIDIA’s Infrastructure Specialist Team, you will serve as the Senior Technical Delivery Manager, owning people management for a team of Senior Networking (Eth/IB/AI/HPC) Solutions Architects and technical specialists, while providing overall technical control for all InfiniBand, HPC, and AI cluster delivery projects in the India and APAC region. You will balance team leadership, technical oversight, and customer\-centric delivery—leveraging your understanding of the APAC business model and Chinese customer needs—to ensure alignment with NVIDIA’s strategic goals and maintain the highest standards of technical excellence and customer satisfaction. Your deep expertise in AI technology and full\-stack DC technologies (storage, server, networking, virtualization, GPU) will be critical to guiding the team and delivering successful projects.
   

  

**What You Will Be Doing**
* Lead, manage, and develop a high\-performing technical team (size: a few to dozens of members) of Senior Networking (ETH/IB) Solutions Architects and technical specialists, overseeing the full people management lifecycle—hiring, onboarding, performance management, career development, coaching, and retention—fostering a collaborative, technically driven team culture. Provide overall technical control for all InfiniBand, HPC, and AI cluster delivery projects in the region, ensuring technical excellence, adherence to NVIDIA DC product standards, and alignment with customer requirements.
* Oversee the design, deployment, and operational reliability of large\-scale AI/HPC infrastructure for new and existing customers in India and APAC, with a focus on InfiniBand networking, HPC clusters, and AI orchestration tools (e.g., BCM \- Base Command Manager).
* Lead technical decision\-making for complex delivery projects, leveraging your deep understanding of AI technology and full\-stack DC technologies (storage, server, networking, virtualization, GPU) to resolve critical technical challenges related to InfiniBand networks, data center architecture, network automation, and GPU\-accelerated infrastructure.
* Drive continuous improvement in delivery processes, leveraging your deep technical expertise to optimize workflows for network provisioning, system design, automation, and post\-deployment support (monitoring, logging, alerting).
* Collaborate closely with cross\-functional teams (engineering, sales, product, support) to align technical delivery strategies with NVIDIA’s product roadmap, especially for NVIDIA DC products (networking, InfiniBand, AI orchestration tools).
* Build and maintain trusted relationships with key customers (including Chinese customers) and partners across India and APAC, leveraging your understanding of the India business model and bilingual communication skills to serve as the technical leadership point of contact for large\-scale AI/HPC delivery projects and address strategic technical and business needs.
* Ensure the team adheres to technical best practices, compliance standards, and NVIDIA’s quality requirements, while driving accountability for project delivery timelines, budgets, and customer satisfaction.
* Monitor team performance, track project progress, and communicate technical delivery status, challenges, and solutions to senior leadership in a clear, data\-driven manner.


**What We Need To See**
* BS/MS/PhD or equivalent professional experience in Computer Science, Electrical/Computer Engineering, Physics, Mathematics, or a related technical field.
* 10\+ years of progressive technical experience in data center infrastructure, or equivalent experience, and 5\+ years of people management experience leading a technical team (size: 10 or more members).
* Strong technical background in NVIDIA DC products (networking solutions, InfiniBand, AI orchestration tools, e.g., BCM \- Base Command Manager), GPU\-accelerated infrastructure, and full\-stack data center technologies including storage, server, networking, virtualization. Additionally, a deep understanding of AI technology and its integration with DC infrastructure is required.
* Deep expertise in networking fundamentals, TCP/IP stack, data center architecture, and InfiniBand networks—with hands\-on experience in medium to large\-scale HPC/AI environments.
* Demonstrated experience overseeing end\-to\-end technical delivery of large\-scale AI/HPC infrastructure projects, with a focus on performance, reliability, and customer satisfaction.
* Strong people management skills: ability to lead, coach, and develop technical teams, foster collaboration, and drive accountability in a fast\-paced, dynamic environment.
* Excellent customer\-facing and communication skills (verbal and written in both languages), enabling effective engagement with customers (including Chinese customers), partners, and cross\-functional teams across the India region.
* A solid understanding of the India business model to address their unique technical and business requirements. Ability to support regional delivery needs and collaborate across time zones.
* Proven track record of resolving complex technical challenges and driving continuous improvement in technical delivery processes.
* Self\-motivated, results\-driven, and able to balance technical oversight with people management responsibilities.


**Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd**
* Linux or Networking Certifications (e.g., CCNP, CCIE, HCIE) or NVIDIA\-related certifications.
* Extensive experience with HPC job schedulers (Slurm, PBS) and cluster management technologies (BCM \- Base Command Manager is a strong plus).
* Experience leading technical teams in a professional services or tech vendor environment, with a focus on top CSP/Cloud/Hyper\-Scale customers in the India.
* Deep understanding of AI/ML workloads, their integration with HPC/InfiniBand infrastructure, and full\-stack DC technologies (storage, server, networking, virtualization, GPU)—with hands\-on experience optimizing performance for GPU\-accelerated systems.

 We, RentoMojo, were founded by IITM alums and serial entrepreneurs who worked out of almost every major city in India in his first five years of corporate career. Frustrated with the hassles of relocating from one place to the other, and tired of finding that perfect cluster of home essentials that suited their lifestyle.
   

  

 "The spending youth, especially the millennials \& Gen Z's prefer staying light, desire flexibility and are value conscious. Willing to experiment with new stuff across categories that make life simpler and not boring, these generations are also sensitive to our planet's sustainability. Our customers and employees identify with what we do '', is what Geetansh Bamania, our Founder and CEO has to say.

title: Network Operations Consultant
description:
**About Gruve**
 Gruve is an innovative software services startup dedicated to transforming enterprises to AI powerhouses. We specialize in cybersecurity, customer experience, cloud infrastructure, and advanced technologies such as Large Language Models (LLMs). Our mission is to assist our customers in their business strategies utilizing their data to make more intelligent decisions. As a well\-funded early\-stage startup, Gruve offers a dynamic environment with strong customer and partner networks.
   

  

**Position Summary**
 Technical lead for the NOC / Network \& Device Management track and L3 for the PulseAI infrastructure layers. Major\-incident commander for network and infrastructure events across the AI Fabrik estate and PulseAI customer environments (GPU servers, control\-plane/infrastructure nodes, OpenShift cluster networking, front\-end and RoCEv2 back\-end fabrics, switches and storage), owner of network operational quality, device lifecycle and change governance, vendor engineering liaison for network and hardware vendors, and the customer\-facing voice for network and infrastructure service reviews; partners with the Security Operations Consultant on cross\-domain incidents and deputises for the Security Operation Manager on infrastructure matters.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Command Severity 1 / P1 major incidents on the network and infrastructure side end to end — fabric, edge and firewall outages, GPU\-server and node hardware faults, RoCEv2 back\-end fabric degradation, OpenShift cluster\-networking and node\-level failures, storage outages — until management command engages; own the technical bridge and the SLA status cadence to customer authorised contacts.
* Own root cause analysis for network and infrastructure incidents: complex RCA on EVPN\-VXLAN/BGP, fabric and edge health, interface/optics and firewall issues across the in\-scope Juniper data\-center devices (QFX, EX, MX) and Cisco cdFMC/FMC, FTD/SRX; GPU\-node, NIC/RDMA and storage\-path faults; and OpenShift node lifecycle, MachineConfig and OVN\-Kubernetes/CNI cluster\-networking problems — with structured problem management to eliminate repeat incidents.
* Chair change advisory for the network estate and the PulseAI infrastructure layers, aligned with the intent\-based (Apstra) fabric design: approve and execute high\-risk changes — fabric node additions, routing changes, firewall policy pushes, firmware/BIOS/GPU driver updates, OpenShift node\-pool and MachineConfig changes, node drain/reboot cycles — enforcing maintenance windows, customer notice and the pre\-change backup gate in coordination with the Security Operations Consultant.
* Own the device and infrastructure lifecycle and preventive\-maintenance roadmap: firmware/BIOS/driver currency, EOL/EOS tracking and spares posture across the Juniper fabric and edge devices, Cisco firewalls, PulseAI GPU and control\-plane nodes, RoCEv2 fabric switches and storage; own GPU\-cluster serviceability and capacity\-governance inputs.
* Own infrastructure observability standards for the NOC pod: fabric, GPU\-cluster, OpenShift node and storage health dashboards in Grafana, streaming/SNMP/syslog telemetry coverage, alert thresholds for the SLA appendix, and the diagnostic runbooks for the GPU / switch / storage / fabric layers of the monitor / remediate / escalate matrix.
* Lead the infrastructure side of customer onboarding: validate GPU servers, nodes, front\-end and back\-end fabric, switches and storage against the environment validation checklist (telemetry reachability per switch, storage throughput, access path via outbound collector, site\-to\-site VPN or jump host) within the 14\-day Ready\-for\-Install window; own the network and infrastructure prerequisites for OpenShift cluster deployment.
* Act as escalation interface and vendor engineering liaison for network and hardware: Juniper and Cisco TAC end to end (including RMA and smart\-hands coordination; Cloudflare where a network issue touches that platform), NVIDIA for GPU hardware, NIC/RDMA and fabric issues, OEM/neocloud and storage vendors for hardware faults; interface to customer network engineering.
* Own network and infrastructure SLAs/KPIs; lead the network\-track input into the monthly operational reviews and quarterly business reviews alongside the Service Delivery Manager.
* Approve runbook and authority\-matrix changes for the NOC pod; develop team capability — certification plan and cross\-training matrix (Juniper, Cisco, Red Hat OpenShift, Kubernetes networking, NVIDIA) for the NOC bench — and drive shift\-quality audits and post\-incident reviews; coordinate with the Security Operations Consultant on cross\-domain incidents and shared reporting.


**Mandatory Qualifications**
* 8–11 years network operations / data\-center infrastructure experience, including prior senior/lead experience in a 24×7 NOC or infrastructure\-operations team.
* Incident\-command track record on network/infrastructure P1s with customer\-visible outcomes.
* Architecture\-level grasp of BGP, EVPN\-VXLAN fabric design and Juniper platforms (QFX, EX, MX), Cisco cdFMC/FMC, FTD/SRX; demonstrated independent RCA ownership on P1/P2/P3 network incidents.
* Deep Kubernetes/OpenShift infrastructure operations experience in production — node lifecycle and MachineConfig, cluster networking (OVN\-Kubernetes / CNI, Cilium), Services/Ingress/LoadBalancer and east\-west flows, storage (CSI/NFS), oc/kubectl diagnostics — with the ability to troubleshoot fabric\-to\-cluster (GKE and OpenShift) connectivity end to end and separate cluster\-side from network\-side faults; Linux (RHEL) administration.
* GPU\-cluster infrastructure experience: NVIDIA GPU Operator and driver/firmware lifecycle, DCGM\-class telemetry, RDMA/RoCEv2 NIC health, lossless\-Ethernet fabric behaviour (PFC/ECN), NVLink/NVSwitch topologies and common GPU hardware failure modes on RTX PRO 6000 / HGX B300\-class servers or equivalent.
* Experience operating against contractual SLAs (acknowledgement, restoration, availability, service credits), chairing change governance, and running vendor TAC / engineering escalations through to fix.
* Crisp written and verbal customer reporting; automation mindset


**Preferred Qualifications**
* JNCIE/JNCIP or CCIE/CCNP; ITIL Foundation/Practitioner.
* Apstra or other intent\-based networking exposure; IaC and Python/Ansible automation for operations.
* Red Hat OpenShift certifications (EX280 / EX380\) or RHCE; CKA; exposure to AI/ML workload scheduling and GPU node pools on OpenShift.
* GPU\-cluster performance troubleshooting — RoCEv2/PFC/ECN tuning, ECMP polarisation, NCCL\-visible latency/jitter — and high\-performance fabric telemetry.
* Data\-center/hyperscale or neocloud network operations background; presales/solutioning exposure.
* Working knowledge of GCP networking (VPC\-native GKE, Cloud Load Balancing) and Cloudflare where network issues touch those platforms.
* JNCIE/JNCIP or CCIE/CCNP; ITIL Foundation/Practitioner.
* Apstra or other intent\-based networking exposure; IaC and Python/Ansible automation for operations.
* Red Hat OpenShift certifications (EX280 / EX380\) or RHCE; CKA; exposure to AI/ML workload scheduling and GPU node pools on OpenShift.


**Why Gruve**
 At Gruve, we foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive and contribute their best work. If you’re passionate about technology and eager to make an impact, we’d love to hear from you.
   

  

 Gruve is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and thank all who apply; however, only those selected for an interview will be contacted.

description:

With that philosophy, we've assembled the best identity team in the world that is passionate about the power of identity.
 



  

 As the fastest\-growing, independent identity governance (IGA) provider, SailPoint helps hundreds of global organizations securely and effectively deliver and manage user access to data and applications residing in the data center, on mobile devices, and in the cloud. The company's innovative product portfolio offers customers an integrated set of core services including identity governance, provisioning, and access management delivered on\-premises or from the cloud (IAM\-as\-a\-service).
 



  

 SailPoint is seeking a Quality Management System (QMS) Manager to join our Engineering Operations team. This is a customer\-facing, highly visible role at the intersection of process governance, multi\-framework compliance readiness, and continuous improvement. The goal is a living system embedded in real workflows, not documentation revived before each audit.
 



  

**The Role**
 This is a highly visible, customer\-facing role responsible for the successful execution and evolution of our SaaS quality management system. You will be:
   

 The central owner of QMS policies, procedures, and records, with clear versioning, ownership, and review cadence.
 


* The primary interface between Engineering, Product, Operations, and Compliance for audit readiness and trust communications.
* Embedded with Engineering leaders to align delivery workflows with control requirements and audit expectations.
* Accountable for strengthening the link between engineering tooling and audit posture, reducing manual evidence effort over time.
* SailPoint's named quality management representative for GxP\-regulated and life\-sciences customers who require an independent, auditable vendor quality function.



**Day to Day** 



* Own QMS maintenance and governance by keeping policies, procedures, and records aligned to real delivery practices.
* Coordinate evidence collection and control mapping across annual certification and attestation cycles.
* Pull and validate evidence from systems of record including Jira, CI/CD, ticketing systems, and access logs.
* Run internal audit cadence and track findings through closure.
* Manage corrective and preventive actions (CAPA), including root\-cause analysis for recurring issues.
* Train teams on process changes and audit expectations, and report quality posture to leadership and customer\-facing stakeholders.
* Support EMEA life\-sciences deals by producing vendor qualification artifacts and engaging directly on customer quality audits.



**To be successful in this role you must:** 



* Bring strong process discipline balanced with pragmatism so systems improve without slowing teams down.
* Communicate clearly across technical and leadership audiences and represent quality posture in high\-visibility customer discussions.
* Have hands\-on fluency with engineering and observability tooling, including Jira, Confluence, CI/CD, and access systems.
* Be highly organized and able to coordinate outputs and timelines across multiple partner teams.



**Responsibilities:** 



* Maintain and govern the QMS, including policy, procedure, and record ownership with defined review cadence.
* Drive readiness and audit coordination across SOC 2, ISO 27001/27017/27018/27701, CSA STAR Level 2, C5 Type 2, TISAX AL3, FedRAMP Moderate, IRAP, and GovRAMP.
* Lead the ISO 9001 certification program scoped to software development and release management, closing the GxP vendor qualification gap for life\-sciences customers.
* Operate the evidence and control environment by validating evidence quality and improving traceability.
* Run internal audit and CAPA programs end\-to\-end, ensuring findings are addressed and recurrence is reduced.
* Drive continuous improvement by using metrics, nonconformance trends, and retrospectives to evolve the QMS.
* Partner with GRC, Security, and customer\-facing teams to support external trust and assurance requests.



**Requirements:** 



* 10\+ years of experience maintaining a QMS in a software or SaaS environment.
* Hands\-on evidence and audit coordination experience in one or more of SOC 2, ISO 27001 family standards, CSA STAR, C5, TISAX, FedRAMP, IRAP, or GovRAMP.
* Working fluency with engineering and observability tooling (e.g., Jira, Confluence, CI/CD, access systems).
* Strong process discipline balanced with pragmatism.
* Clear cross\-functional communicator comfortable with engineering, leadership, and customer\-facing audiences.



**Desired Qualifications:** 



* Direct experience supporting multiple frameworks including ISO 27001/27017/27018/27701, CSA STAR Level 2, C5 Type 2, TISAX AL3, FedRAMP Moderate, IRAP, and GovRAMP.
* ISO 9001 certification program experience, ideally scoped to software development and release management in a SaaS environment.
* Exposure to GxP, GAMP 5, or life\-sciences vendor qualification requirements.
* Exposure to evidence automation or GRC tooling.
* Background partnering with GRC or security functions.
* Hands\-on experience using AI\-assisted and agent\-orchestrated workflows to accelerate planning, tracking, and communication across complex, multi\-team programs, with sound judgment about when automation helps and when human oversight is required.
* Proven ability to design and maintain program tracking in Jira and Confluence that drives accountability and executive\-ready visibility.



**Roadmap for Success**
**By 30 days** 
 — Discovery \& Assessment:
 


* Conduct 1:1s with key stakeholders across Engineering, Product, Compliance, and EMEA commercial leadership to map the quality and GxP landscape.
* Establish SailPoint's named Quality Management Representative designation — internal and customer\-facing — to address immediate vendor qualification requests from life\-sciences accounts.
* Complete a QMS document inventory in Confluence (policies, procedures, records), including owners, review cadences, and gaps versus actual engineering practice.
* Take ownership of the stalled ISO 9001 gap assessment and schedule kickoff with the incumbent auditor (Coalfire or equivalent).
* Inherit the 2026 QMS annual review program (ISCREGCOM) and assess status of in\-flight document review tasks.
* Review active audit and certification cycles (SOC 2, ISO 27001 family, FedRAMP, etc.) to baseline current evidence collection pain points.
* Map the GxP opportunity tracker and identify Tier 1 at\-risk accounts requiring immediate quality engagement.



**By 90 days — Planning, Governance \& Early Execution:** 



* Deliver a QMS Health Assessment covering current state versus ISO 9001:2015 (scoped to product development and release management), with a gap severity matrix, control\-to\-evidence map, and 90\-day execution plan approved by Eng Ops and Compliance.
* Finalize scoped certification statement of applicability and remediation plan sequenced toward a 6–9 month ISO 9001 target.
* Launch the internal audit program and stand up CAPA tracking in Jira with aging dashboards visible to leadership.
* Complete or accelerate the 2026 QMS annual review with ISO 9001 clause traceability on reviewed documents.
* Publish GxP Vendor Qualification Pack v1 for Sales/SE, including quality overview, SDLC summary, AWS shared\-responsibility inheritance, and named quality contact.
* Engage directly on Tier 1 at\-risk GxP accounts to understand vendor qualification checklists and deliver tailored responses.
* Build an evidence collection playbook mapping top controls to systems of record (Jira, CI/CD, Confluence, ServiceNow, access logs).
* Schedule or complete Stage 1 (documentation/readiness) audit with the certification body.
* Establish a monthly quality posture report for Eng Ops leadership covering audit status, CAPA aging, ISO 9001 progress, and GxP account support.



**By 6 months — Audit Readiness \& GxP Framework:** 



* Close critical ISO 9001 gap remediations and advance toward Stage 2 certification audit readiness.
* Formalize procedures for change control, release governance, internal audit, CAPA, and management review aligned to ISO 9001 Clauses 8, 9, and 10\.
* Deliver GAMP 5 alignment documentation v1 mapping SailPoint SDLC controls to life\-sciences vendor qualification expectations.
* Produce AWS inheritance package documenting how SailPoint leverages AWS ISO 9001 certification and AWS Artifact evidence per the GxP Compliance Framework.
* Run at least one full internal audit cycle and demonstrate CAPA backlog trending toward closure.
* Pilot evidence automation for high\-effort manual controls, reducing collection time for recurring certification cycles.
* Deliver account\-specific quality responses for top at\-risk EMEA opportunities and partner with commercial leadership to tag GxP as a loss/risk reason in Salesforce.
* Conduct QMS awareness training for Engineering managers on audit expectations, CAPA participation, and quality embedded in delivery workflows.



**By 1 year — Certify, Sustain \& Extend:** 



* Achieve scoped ISO 9001:2015 certification for software development and release management processes.
* Operate the QMS as a living system — clean audit and certification cycles across existing frameworks with no avoidable evidence gaps or last\-minute scrambles.
* Sustain internal audit cadence and CAPA program with measurable process adoption across partner teams.
* Expand evidence automation to cover the majority of recurring control evidence, materially reducing manual effort.
* Advance GAMP 5 and 21 CFR Part 11 positioning for the most demanding life\-sciences customers, with a clear roadmap for full pharmaceutical\-grade QMS if life sciences is confirmed as a strategic vertical.
* Serve as the durable quality function for customer audits, vendor qualification, and trust communications — converting the GxP compliance gap from a revenue blocker into a competitive advantage.

title: Software Asset Management (SAM) Lead
description:
**About Us**
 We are the independent expert in assurance and risk management. Driven by our purpose, to safeguard life, property, and the environment, we empower our customers and their stakeholders with facts and reliable insights so that critical decisions can be made with confidence.
   

  

 As a trusted voice for many of the world’s most successful organizations, we use our knowledge to advance safety and performance, set industry benchmarks, and inspire and invent solutions to tackle global transformations.
   

  

**About GSS**
 As the internal support organization for DNV and DNV owned companies, we deliver shared services within Human Resources, Finance, IT and Real Estate \& Procurement to DNV globally. Our mission is to enable DNV to grow, succeed with its business goals and improve competitiveness. Customer experience is at the core of everything we do. GSS is responsible for many of the tools, processes and daily routines that create the backbone of DNV.
   

  

**About The Role**
**Build a global capability. Shape the future of software governance at DNV.**
 DNV is an independent assurance and risk management provider, operating in more than 100 countries. Through our broad experience and deep expertise, we advance safety and sustainable performance, set industry standards, and inspire and invent solutions.
   

  

 Global Shared Services IT (GSS IT) delivers secure, modern, and cost\-efficient IT services to all of DNV. As part of our enterprise software governance ambition, we have established a centralized Software Asset Management (SAM) function to govern how software is acquired, used, managed, and optimized across the company.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
**This is not a role where you simply maintain an established function.** 
**This is an opportunity to shape and scale one.**
 We are looking for an experienced Head of Section \- SAM Lead to take ownership of our newly established global Software Asset Management function and develop it into a permanent, high\-performing capability with enterprise\-wide impact.
   

  

 Today, the SAM function operates as a contractor\-led organization reporting directly to the GSS IT Director. Your mission will be to transform this foundation into a sustainable, employee\-led function that becomes DNV's central authority for software governance, licensing, compliance, optimization, and asset intelligence.
   

  

 With strong executive sponsorship and visibility across all Business Areas, you will shape the strategy, operating model, governance structure, and team while influencing decisions that impact software investments, risk management, compliance, and cybersecurity across DNV.
   

  

**As Head of Section – SAM, you will own the SAM operating model, governance, KPIs, audit readiness, and stakeholder alignment across GSS IT and DNV's Business Areas.**
**Specifically, You Will**
* Own the SAM function end\-to\-end – strategy, roadmap, KPI framework, governance, and reporting to GSS IT leadership and the SAM SteerCo.
* Build and lead the permanent team – recruit, onboard, and develop the SAM core team (SAM Operations \& Tooling Responsible, SAM Licensing Specialist), and transition knowledge from the current contractor\-led setup to a permanent organisation.
* Run the Managed / Co\-Managed / Governed operating model – allocate operational responsibility by risk, complexity, spend, and strategic importance across DNV's software estate.
* Deliver Phase 2 of the SAM project – expand scope beyond Phase 1 (launched 1 April 2026\), including broader vendor coverage, optimization, and maturity uplift throughout 2026\.
* Ensure audit readiness and compliance – establish Effective License Position (ELP) methodology, audit defence playbooks, and a robust vendor compliance posture for major vendors.
* Drive data quality and tooling – ensure Snow Atlas, discovery, inventory, and integrations deliver a reliable single source of truth for software assets.
* Govern the software lifecycle in MyGSS and the VerIT Store – partner closely with Digital Workplace on software intake, fulfilment, renewals, and retirement, ensuring a seamless and secure user experience.
* Enable cross\-functional governance – establish and run a standing SAM Governance Board with Digital Workplace, Cloud Infrastructure, EA/D\&A/Security, RemProc (Procurement), Finance, and BA representation.
* Optimize cost and risk – identify license optimization opportunities, support renewal and negotiation strategies, and reduce shadow IT in collaboration with Security.
* Be the face of SAM in DNV – build trust and credibility with BAs, GSS IT Heads of Group, Procurement, and senior stakeholders, and represent SAM externally with vendors and auditors.


 What we offer
   

  

**Why join us?**
* Build and lead a strategic global capability from an early stage
* Shape DNV's approach to software governance, compliance, and optimization
* Partner with senior stakeholders across IT, Procurement, Finance, Security, and the Business Areas
* Combine strategy, governance, commercial management, and people leadership in one role
* Join a purpose\-driven organization committed to safeguarding life, property, and the environment


**What We Offer**
* A highly visible Head of Section role with a clear enterprise mandate and direct access to GSS IT leadership.
* The opportunity to shape and lead a strategic new function from day one.
* A global, diverse, and professional environment with strong development opportunities.
* Competitive compensation and benefits, aligned with DNV's local market practice in Norway and India.
* A purpose\-driven organization committed to safeguarding life, property, and the environment.


*DNV is an Equal Opportunity Employer and gives consideration for employment to qualified applicants without regard to gender, religion, race, national or ethnic origin, cultural background, social group, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, age or political opinion. Diversity is fundamental to our culture and we invite you to be part of this diversity.*
**About You**
 We are looking for a builder, operator, and people leader — someone who combines strategic thinking with a strong delivery mindset and the ability to lead through influence in a complex, global organisation.
   

  

**Must\-have Qualifications**
* Significant experience in Software Asset Management, IT Asset Management, software licensing, or IT vendor and commercial management — ideally including the build\-up of a SAM/ITAM function.
* Demonstrated people leadership experience at Head of Section level or equivalent, ideally leading globally distributed teams.
* Proven understanding of licensing models and audit and compliance management for major software vendors (e.g., Microsoft, Oracle, Salesforce, Adobe).
* Experience working with SAM tooling (Snow Atlas, ServiceNow SAM, Flexera, or similar) and the data foundations behind it (discovery, normalization, CMDB integration).
* Strong governance and stakeholder management capabilities, with a track record of working across IT, Procurement, Finance, Security, and business stakeholders.
* Solid commercial acumen – understanding of contracts, ELPs, renewals, and total cost of ownership.
* Excellent communication skills in English; ability to communicate clearly at executive level.


**Nice To Have**
* Industry certifications such as IAITAM (CSAM/CITAM), ITIL, or equivalent.
* Experience leading a global function across multiple regions and time zones.
* Experience with FinOps, SaaS governance, or shadow IT detection.
* Experience operating in a regulated environment or under frameworks such as NIS2, ISO 27001, or similar.


**Who You Are**
 You are not only a SAM expert. You are a builder and leader who enjoys creating structure, driving change, and bringing people together around a common goal.
   

  

**You Thrive When**
* Building something new rather than maintaining the status quo.
* Turning complexity into practical and scalable solutions.
* Using data to make decisions and drive accountability.
* Navigating diverse stakeholder interests and building trust across organizational boundaries.
* Continuously improving processes, governance, and ways of working.


**Recruitment process – internal and external in parallel**
 To ensure we identify the strongest candidate, this role will be advertised and recruited simultaneously internally and externally, and in both Høvik and Pune.
   

  

 We strongly encourage qualified DNV colleagues with relevant SAM, ITAM, licensing, or IT commercial governance experience to apply alongside external candidates. Internal applications will be treated on equal terms with external applications, with the final decision based on overall fit, capability, and ability to build the function.
   

  

 The application deadline is 31 August 2026; however, we will be reviewing applications continuously throughout the recruitment process. Early applications are encouraged.
   

  

*Security and compliance with statutory requirements in the countries in which we operate is essential for DNV. Background checks will be conducted on all final candidates as part of the offer process, in accordance with applicable country\-specific laws and practices.*

title: Security Operations Consultant
description:
**About Gruve**
 Gruve is an innovative software services startup dedicated to transforming enterprises to AI powerhouses. We specialize in cybersecurity, customer experience, cloud infrastructure, and advanced technologies such as Large Language Models (LLMs). Our mission is to assist our customers in their business strategies utilizing their data to make more intelligent decisions. As a well\-funded early\-stage startup, Gruve offers a dynamic environment with strong customer and partner networks.
   

  

**Position Summary**
 Senior technical lead across SOC, NOC and PulseAI Managed Services. Runs major\-incident response, owns the detection\-content and tuning program, and is L3 for PulseAI operations: owns root cause analysis, works platform defects with the Gruve PulseAI engineering team, leads OpenShift lifecycle operations and emergency remediation, acts as vendor engineering liaison (Red Hat, NVIDIA, OEMs), and deputises for the Security Operation Manager.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Lead technical response on Severity 1/2 incidents across security, network and PulseAI platform until management command engages; own the SLA status cadence (hourly / every 30 minutes on Severity 1\) to customer authorised contacts.
* Own root cause analysis for PulseAI and OpenShift incidents; reproduce and characterise platform defects and route them to Gruve PulseAI product engineering; own the corrective\-action backlog and problem management to eliminate recurring incidents.
* Own the PulseAI operations practice: severity classification standards, diagnostic runbooks for platform/OpenShift/GPU/switch/storage layers, Grafana observability standards, alert thresholds for the SLA appendix, and the monitor / remediate / escalate matrix as applied per customer.
* Lead OpenShift lifecycle operations for PulseAI customers — y\-stream upgrades on customer approval within the agreed window of the Red Hat release, operator and node\-pool changes, GPU driver/firmware currency, emergency vulnerability remediation — enforcing the pre\-change backup gate.
* Act as vendor engineering liaison: Red Hat for OpenShift product defects, NVIDIA for GPU Operator/driver/NVIDIA AI Enterprise issues, OEM/neocloud/storage vendors for hardware — including the third\-party platform variant (Rafay, vCluster, vNode, NVIDIA Run:ai, Red Hat OpenShift AI) where restoration is best\-effort with committed vendor escalation.
* Lead customer onboarding technically: deploy and validate OpenShift and PulseAI within the 14\-day Ready\-for\-Install window, configure identity provider federation and initial tenancy structure, onboard the environment to monitoring via the agreed connectivity pattern (outbound collector, site\-to\-site VPN or jump host with just\-in\-time elevation), and complete the countersigned environment validation checklist.
* Own the detection\-content backlog and tuning program; own log\-pipeline integration health with escalation into engineering.
* Approve and execute high\-risk changes; cross\-train the L1/L2 bench across towers; drive shift\-quality audits and post\-incident reviews.


**Mandatory Qualifications**
* 8–11 years with prior senior/lead experience in SOC, NOC or 24×7 platform operations and genuine cross\-domain fluency.
* Incident command capability; deep SIEM content and query skills.
* Strong Kubernetes/GKE security operations depth — onboarding kube\-audit and workload telemetry, building detection content for container attack paths (MITRE ATT\&CK for Containers), and tuning Cilium/Hubble\-based use cases.
* Deep Red Hat OpenShift / Kubernetes operations experience in production — multi\-node cluster administration, operators, y/z\-stream upgrades, RBAC, storage and networking, observability stack (Grafana, metrics, logs, alerting), backup/restore of cluster and platform state — with a track record of platform diagnostics and RCA.
* GPU\-cluster operations experience: NVIDIA GPU Operator/driver lifecycle, NVIDIA AI Enterprise components (NIM), DCGM\-class telemetry, node health and capacity management for AI inference workloads on RTX PRO 6000 / HGX B300\-class servers or equivalent.
* Experience operating against contractual SLAs (acknowledgement, restoration, availability, service credits) and running vendor engineering escalations through to fix.
* Advanced network troubleshooting; automation mindset.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Advanced incident\-handling / intrusion\-analysis certification, or expert\-level networking certification.
* CKS or equivalent; experience running K8s posture/runtime security tooling in production.
* Red Hat certifications (EX280 / EX380 / RHCE); exposure to Rafay, vCluster, NVIDIA Run:ai or Red Hat OpenShift AI; MLOps or AI\-platform operations (model\-serving endpoints, GPU scheduling, quota governance).
* Exposure to HashiCorp Vault, SAML 2\.0 SSO federation, and CSI/NFS storage for model artefacts.
* MSSP/managed\-services background; AI\-SOC tooling exposure.
* Correlating GPU\-platform performance anomalies (utilization, thermal, fabric saturation) with security events to separate abuse, crypto\-mining or misconfiguration from genuine workload load.


**Why Gruve**
 At Gruve, we foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive and contribute their best work. If you’re passionate about technology and eager to make an impact, we’d love to hear from you.
   

  

 Gruve is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and thank all who apply; however, only those selected for an interview will be contacted.

title: Assistant Manager-Net IQ - IAM, IDM-L2 Support
description:
**Join Us**
 At Vodafone, we’re working hard to build a better future. A more connected, inclusive and sustainable world. As a dynamic global community, it's our human spirit, together with technology, that empowers us to achieve this.
   

  

 We challenge and innovate in order to connect people, businesses, and communities across the world. Delighting our customers and earning their loyalty drive us, and we experiment, learn fast and get it done, together.
   

  

 With us, you can be truly be yourself and belong, share inspiration, embrace new opportunities, thrive, and make a real difference.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
**NetIQ IAM and IDM technical operations**
* Operate, monitor and troubleshoot NetIQ Identity Manager and associated IAM services across identity lifecycle, provisioning, de\-provisioning, access, authentication and synchronisation processes
* Analyse drivers, connectors, policies, workflows, queues, jobs, events, interfaces and connected\-system dependencies
* Restore failed identity\-processing activities within agreed service targets
* Investigate identity data, attributes, mappings, role and entitlement assignments, reconciliation outcomes and connector communication issues
* Perform approved administration, health checks, restarts and recovery activities in accordance with established runbooks and controls


**Identity lifecycle and access support**
* Support joiner, mover and leaver processes, access requests, approvals, exceptions and role or entitlement changes
* Troubleshoot delayed or unsuccessful provisioning and de\-provisioning across directories and connected target systems
* Investigate access\-review exceptions, orphaned and dormant accounts and reconciliation issues
* Track remediation activities to completion while following applicable access\-control and security procedures


**Incident, problem and service management**
* Lead L2 technical analysis and service restoration for high\-priority IAM and IDM incidents
* Coordinate cross\-domain troubleshooting with L3 support, security, directory, database, infrastructure, network and vendor teams
* Conduct root\-cause analysis, document workarounds and track corrective actions
* Help reduce recurring identity\-service failures through structured problem management
* Manage incidents, problems and service requests using ITIL practices
* Monitor ageing work items, SLA risks and service\-impacting backlogs.


**Monitoring, automation and continual improvement**
* Analyse NetIQ, directory, application\-server, database and operating\-system logs to identify production failures and performance issues
* Maintain dashboards, alerts and service health checks
* Improve alert quality and proactive detection across critical identity processes
* Automate repetitive operational activities using Shell scripting, SQL, PL/SQL and approved orchestration tools
* Develop automation for health checks, reconciliation validation, reporting and repeatable service activities


**AI and AIOps for IAM operations**
* Identify suitable AI and AIOps use cases for incident triage, anomaly detection, event and log correlation, SLA\-risk identification, knowledge retrieval and root\-cause analysis
* Use approved AI capabilities to support faster diagnosis and improve the reuse of operational knowledge
* Retain appropriate human validation for access, security, compliance and remediation decisions


**Operational governance and knowledge management**
* Provide clear SLA, KPI, incident, problem, automation and service\-improvement updates during operational reviews
* Maintain runbooks, technical support documentation, known\-error records, recovery procedures and audit evidence
* Contribute to measurable improvements in service availability, provisioning accuracy, restoration performance, monitoring coverage and operational efficiency


**Who You Are**
**Essential experience and qualifications**
* You have at least two years of experience in IT operations, IAM, IDM or enterprise application support, including hands\-on production responsibilities
* You have practical production\-support experience with NetIQ Identity Manager and identity lifecycle processes
* You can troubleshoot NetIQ drivers, connectors, synchronisation processes, provisioning activities, workflows, directories and system integrations
* You have working knowledge of Unix or Linux, Shell scripting and SQL or PL/SQL
* You have experience managing incidents, problems and service requests in an SLA\-driven production environment
* You can analyse complex production issues, coordinate L3 or vendor support and document root causes and corrective actions clearly
* You have experience using monitoring and observability tools and implementing practical operational automation
* You demonstrate strong analytical, communication and stakeholder\-coordination skills
* You hold a bachelor’s degree or have equivalent relevant professional experience.


**Technical knowledge**
* NetIQ Identity Manager administration and production support
* Identity lifecycle processes, including joiners, movers, leavers, provisioning, de\-provisioning, roles, entitlements, access requests and approvals
* NetIQ drivers, connectors, policies, workflows, synchronisation, reconciliation and event processing
* Directory services and integration concepts, including LDAP and Active Directory
* NetIQ eDirectory, Identity Applications, Identity Reporting, Designer, Identity Console and Remote Loader
* WebLogic or an equivalent application server, including service, JVM, log and connectivity checks
* REST and SOAP integration concepts, certificates, service accounts and network troubleshooting
* Monitoring and observability tools such as Dynatrace, Kibana, Datadog, AppDynamics, Splunk or Zabbix


**Professional Capabilities**
* Structured incident and problem\-solving skills
* Knowledge of Incident, Problem, Change and Service Request Management
* Understanding of ITIL practices and SLA or KPI\-driven production support
* Awareness of identity security, access controls, audit evidence and compliance requirements
* Ability to collaborate effectively with technical teams, service stakeholders and external vendors
* A continual\-improvement mindset with an interest in automation and responsible AI adoption


**Desirable Experience**
* ITIL, IAM or NetIQ certification
* Experience with Oracle Identity and Access Management or another enterprise IAM or identity governance platform
* Exposure to privileged access management, identity governance or access\-certification processes
* Familiarity with AIOps, generative AI\-assisted operations, intelligent triage, anomaly detection or knowledge\-assistant use cases


**Not a perfect fit?**
 Concerned you may not meet every requirement? Vodafone is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. If you are excited about this role but your experience does not align exactly with every aspect of the job description, you are encouraged to apply. You may be the right candidate for this or another opportunity, and the recruitment team will support you in exploring where your skills fit best.
   

  

**What's In It For You**
* An opportunity to develop specialist expertise in NetIQ Identity Manager and enterprise identity operations
* Exposure to business\-critical identity lifecycle, access governance and security processes
* Experience working collaboratively with security, infrastructure, application, database, network and vendor teams
* Opportunities to implement practical automation that reduces manual effort and improves service reliability
* Exposure to approved AI and AIOps capabilities for intelligent monitoring, incident triage, anomaly detection and operational knowledge management
* The opportunity to contribute to measurable service improvements across availability, provisioning accuracy, incident restoration, monitoring and compliance


**Who We Are**
 VOIS (Vodafone Intelligent Solutions) is a strategic arm of Vodafone Group Plc, creating value for customers by delivering intelligent solutions through Talent, Technology \& Transformation.
   

  

 As the largest shared services organisation in the global telco industry with 30,000 FTE, our portfolio of next\-generation solutions and services are designed in partnership with customers across Vodafone Group, local markets, and partner markets to simplify and drive growth. With our strategic partner Accenture, we work alongside our Vodafone customers, other Telco and tech companies to drive transformation, meet the challenges of our industry and ensure we stay relevant and resilient. This partnership is a unique, industry\-first model which brings together the best of in\-house and 3rd party capability.
   

  

 We work with customers across 28 countries from 10 VOIS locations: Albania, Egypt, Hungary, India, Romania, Spain, Turkey, UK, Germany, Ireland, and with a network of teams in Czech Republic, Italy, Greece, and Portugal.
   

  

 \#VOIS \#BeUnrivalled \#CreateTheFuture
