title: Operations Manager
description:
Join us as a Operations Manager at Barclays, where you'll spearhead the evolution of our digital landscape, driving innovation and excellence. You'll harness cutting\-edge technology to revolutionise our digital offerings, ensuring unapparelled customer experiences.
   

  

 To be successful as a Operations Manager, must be subject matter expert providing a world class range of operational and transactional services for the benefit schemes that are provided to Barclays employees; engaging with key stakeholders within the Rewards \& Performance centres of excellence, external suppliers, and colleagues within the Benefits employee helpdesk.
   

  

**About Human Resources (HR)**
 The Barclays HR purpose is “making Barclays a great place to work”. From recruitment to retention, skills development to talent management, Barclays HR supports them all. The HR Function is made up of 1,500 people globally including centres of expertise specialising in diversity and inclusion; employee relations; learning; resourcing; reward and performance; and HR operations.
   

  

 We want to create the best possible experience for our colleagues \- whether they’re experienced professionals or just starting out. We offer them plenty of opportunities to develop and get the most from their careers.
   

  

 HR Operations provide their support through Global HR Service Centres, consisting of approximately 350 colleagues based across India, UK, US and APAC.
   

  

 ­­­­­­­­­­­­­­­­­­
   

  

 Overall purpose of role
   

  

 Subject Matter Expert providing a world class range of operational and transactional services for the benefit schemes that are provided to Barclays employees; engaging with key stakeholders within the Rewards \& Performance centres of excellence, external suppliers, and colleagues within the Benefits employee helpdesk.
   

  

 Key Accountabilities
   

  

  

* Subject Matter Expert in Pensions and Benefits and how they operate, working towards pre\-defined targets.
* Operating best\-in\-class end to end processes and controls.
* To lead on the delivery of Benefits and Rewards impacting projects incorporating change and business migration to agreed timescale, quality, ensuring objectives are delivered and improvements achieved.
* To deliver Service Level Agreements and Key Performance Indicators.


**Operational Processing and Service Excellence**
* Develop, manage and maintain Benefits operational procedures and practices.
* Ensure that Benefit operational servicing and processing meets the needs of the customer and the business through stakeholder discussion.
* Responsible for query escalation and complaint handling for queries relating to Benefits and prompt root cause analysis of issues/planning and on\-time delivery of rectification activities as required.
* To liaise with the Reward Transaction Cycle to define and administer the benefits incorporating legislative, system, operational and business changes, communications to customers and testing, as required.
* Co\-ordinate and report all Benefit risks in line with HR guidelines including compliance with legislation, ensuring robust plans are in place and executed to time/quality.
* Analyse and report on Benefit related MI and any business opportunities or themes supported by the data.


**Operational Change Management**
* Identify opportunities to develop the service in line with the Benefit provision, Policy guidance, best practise and operational efficiencies.
* Work in partnership with the wider HR Operational and Control teams to shape and develop the customer experience and deliver Benefit related business objectives.
* Work in partnership with governing bodies or Reward Policy team to ensure implementation and delivery of legislative and policy change.
* Make operational change decisions based on an evaluation of risk, cost, resource availability, customer service and overall impact on Benefit operational servicing \& processing model.
* Operate and evaluate implemented process, procedure and policy change and feedback to relevant parties.
* Support transitional change activity to either embed new operational services or migrate services to other areas of HR Operations.


 Stakeholder Management and Leadership
   

  

  

* Lead on specific benefit related projects as required.
* Responsible for the provision of progress updates to Line Management and Stakeholders, identifying and reporting areas of Risk and escalating issues in a timely manner.
* Establishing day to day relationships with peers within HR business and customer to manage the smooth transition of the project from inception through to live, supporting the project in the realisation of anticipated benefits.


 Decision\-making and Problem Solving
   

  

  

* Build trust through credible use of facts and data and possesses ability to creatively resolve problems and issues at pace.
* Analyse problems and evaluate options prior to decision making \- commit to a course of action after identifying and assessing alternatives based on logical assumptions, facts, resources, constraints and organisational values.


**Risk and Control Objective**
 Ensure that all activities and duties are carried out in full compliance with regulatory requirements, Enterprise Wide Risk Management Framework and internal Barclays Policies and Policy Standards.
   

  

 Person Specification
   

  

  

* SME in Pensions and Benefits operation
* Proven ability to effectively manage multiple priorities/projects, ensuring consistent delivery to a high standard and customer satisfaction.
* Strong communication, presentation and negotiation skills with the ability to influence and build commitment amongst senior stakeholders.
* Demonstrate resilience \- reacts positively to changes and maintains poise, focus and flexibility when encountering difficulties or obstacles.
* Possess a demonstrable ability to effectively engage with stakeholders, whilst being able to clearly communicate requirements and liaise with peers who are required to support the delivery.


**Essential Skills/Basic Qualifications**
* Degree qualified or with equivalent professional qualifications or demonstrable experience in lieu of this
* Experience of Benefits, governance, controls and risk management.
* Excellent people management skills in relation to performance, motivation, development and delivery
* Customer Service experience – ability to deal with a varied customer base, including business customers \& senior stakeholders, and explain complex queries clearly


**Desirable Skills/Preferred Qualifications**
* Preferably degree qualified in a numerate or HR\-related discipline
* Experience of working within a HR operational and service delivery environment
* Generalist HR experience within complex organisations


 Purpose, Values
 **and Mindset**
 We deploy finance responsibly to support people and businesses, acting with empathy and integrity, championing innovation and sustainability, for the common good and the long term.
   

  

 Our values underpin everything we do: Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship.
   

  

 Respect
   

  

 We harness the power of diversity and inclusion in our business, trust those we work with, and value everyone's contribution.
   

  

 Integrity
   

  

 We operate with honesty, transparency and fairness in all we do.
   

  

 Service
   

  

 We act with empathy and humility, putting the people and businesses we serve at the centre of what we do.
   

  

 Excellence
   

  

 We champion innovation, and use our energy, expertise and resources to make a positive difference.
   

  

 Stewardship
   

  

 We prize sustainability, and are passionate about leaving things better than we found them.
   

  

 Our Mindset shapes how we take action, living by our Values, driven by our Purpose, always with our customers and clients at the heart of what we do; our Mindset is to Empower, Challenge and Drive.
   

  

 Empower
   

  

 Trust and support each other to deliver. Make decisions with those closest to the topic. Include diverse perspectives. Celebrate success and learn from failure.
   

  

 Challenge
   

  

 Question whether things can be done better. Use insights based on data to inform decisions. Be curious about how we can adapt and improve. Speak up and be open to alternative viewpoints.
   

  

 Drive
   

  

 Focus on outcomes. Deliver with pace. Be passionate and ambitious about what we do. Take personal responsibility. Actively build collaborative relationships to get things done.
   

  

 You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as experience with pensions and benefits experience.
   

  

 The role is based out of Pune.
   

  

**Purpose of the role**
 To design and implement programmes and initiatives that support the growth and development of the bank’s employees and leaders.
   

  

**Accountabilities**
* Development and implementation of training and development programmes and initiatives, including creation and execution of training sessions, workshops, and other learning opportunities.
* Collaboration with HR and hiring managers to analyse the current and future development needs of the organisation.
* Design and delivery of classroom and digital based training content, programmes and associated User Experience.
* Management of onboarding programmes including training, onboarding materials, introduction meetings and providing support throughout the onboarding process.
* Analysis of data and metrics to measure success of talent development programmes and initiatives.
* Development and implementation of coaching and mentoring programmes, train the trainer programmes for facilitators and relevant educational materials.
* Develop and implement talent pipelining processes, identifying, managing, progressing and promoting talent capability across the bank with succession management and career progression’.


**Assistant Vice President Expectations**
* To advise and influence decision making, contribute to policy development and take responsibility for operational effectiveness. Collaborate closely with other functions/ business divisions.
* Lead a team performing complex tasks, using well developed professional knowledge and skills to deliver on work that impacts the whole business function. Set objectives and coach employees in pursuit of those objectives, appraisal of performance relative to objectives and determination of reward outcomes
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
* OR for an individual contributor, they will lead collaborative assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will identify new directions for assignments and/ or projects, identifying a combination of cross functional methodologies or practices to meet required outcomes.
* Consult on complex issues; providing advice to People Leaders to support the resolution of escalated issues.

 Level: Manager / Senior Manager
 








**About HummingBird** 




 HummingBird, an AI\-powered Total Talent Workforce Platform powered by LanceSoft, helps enterprises transform how they source, engage, manage, and optimize their workforce.
 



 Built for complex enterprise hiring environments, HummingBird brings together AI\-powered talent matching, workforce analytics, recruitment automation, and integrated talent management capabilities to support permanent, contingent, and Statement of Work (SOW) workforce programs.
 



 HummingBird is hiring on behalf of its client, a Fortune 500 company, for an experienced Contingent Workforce Program Manager based in Pune.
 








**About the Role** 




 We are seeking an accomplished Contingent Workforce Program Manager with 8–12 years of experience in managing enterprise contingent workforce programs, vendor ecosystems, workforce operations, and compliance frameworks.
 



 The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in Managed Service Provider (MSP) programs, Vendor Management Systems (VMS), contingent workforce governance, supplier management, workforce analytics, and cost optimization.
 



 This role will be responsible for overseeing the end\-to\-end contingent workforce lifecycle, driving operational excellence, strengthening supplier partnerships, and ensuring workforce programs align with organizational objectives.
 








**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. Contingent Workforce Strategy \& Program Management** 



* Develop and execute contingent workforce strategies aligned with enterprise workforce objectives.
* Manage end\-to\-end contingent workforce programs covering sourcing, onboarding, engagement, extensions, and offboarding.
* Establish scalable operating models for contingent labor management across business functions.
* Drive standardization of workforce processes, policies, and governance frameworks.
* Partner with business leaders to understand workforce requirements and optimize contingent talent utilization.



**2\. MSP \& VMS Management** 



* Oversee Managed Service Provider (MSP) relationships and program performance.
* Manage and optimize Vendor Management Systems (VMS) such as SAP Fieldglass, Beeline, or equivalent platforms.
* Ensure effective requisition management, supplier distribution, candidate submissions, approvals, and onboarding workflows.
* Monitor MSP service delivery against established SLAs and KPIs.
* Identify opportunities for process automation and operational improvements.



**3\. Supplier \& Vendor Management** 



* Develop and manage a high\-performing contingent workforce supplier ecosystem.
* Conduct supplier performance reviews and establish measurable scorecards.
* Monitor supplier quality, responsiveness, fulfillment rates, and compliance.
* Support supplier selection, onboarding, contract negotiations, and performance improvement.
* Drive supplier rationalization and strategic vendor partnerships where appropriate.



**4\. Workforce Compliance \& Risk Management** 



* Ensure contingent workforce programs comply with applicable labor laws, contractual obligations, and enterprise policies.
* Establish governance for worker classification, tenure management, onboarding documentation, and offboarding.
* Collaborate with Legal, HR, Procurement, Finance, and Compliance teams to mitigate workforce\-related risks.
* Maintain appropriate audit trails, documentation, and compliance reporting.
* Support governance for Independent Contractors (IC), temporary workers, and SOW engagements.



**5\. Financial Management \& Cost Optimization** 



* Manage contingent workforce budgets, spend visibility, and cost\-control initiatives.
* Analyze labor rates, supplier markups, workforce utilization, and program expenditures.
* Develop rate\-card governance and support commercial negotiations.
* Identify opportunities for cost savings through supplier optimization, process improvements, and workforce planning.
* Provide financial insights and recommendations to senior stakeholders.



**6\. Workforce Analytics \& Reporting** 



* Establish and monitor key contingent workforce metrics, including:
* Time\-to\-fill and requisition aging
* Supplier fulfillment and submission quality
* Contingent workforce spend
* Cost savings and cost avoidance
* Worker tenure and utilization
* Compliance adherence
* Hiring manager satisfaction
* MSP and supplier SLA performance
* Develop executive dashboards and management reports.
* Leverage workforce analytics to improve decision\-making and program effectiveness.



**7\. Stakeholder Management** 



* Partner with Procurement, HR, Talent Acquisition, Finance, Legal, and business leadership.
* Act as the primary point of contact for contingent workforce program operations.
* Facilitate governance meetings, supplier reviews, and program performance discussions.
* Provide guidance to hiring managers on contingent workforce policies and processes.
* Build strong relationships with internal stakeholders and external workforce partners.



**8\. Program Transformation \& Continuous Improvement** 



* Identify opportunities to enhance workforce program efficiency through automation, AI, and digital technologies.
* Support MSP/VMS implementation, migration, or optimization initiatives.
* Drive continuous improvement across sourcing, onboarding, supplier management, and compliance.
* Contribute to Total Talent Management initiatives integrating permanent and contingent workforce strategies.








**Required Qualifications** 



* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, Procurement, or a related discipline.
* 8–12 years of experience in Contingent Workforce Management, MSP Program Management, Workforce Operations, or Strategic Procurement.
* Proven experience managing enterprise\-scale contingent workforce programs.
* Strong understanding of MSP operating models and VMS platforms.
* Hands\-on experience with SAP Fieldglass, Beeline, or similar workforce management systems.
* Experience managing staffing suppliers and vendor performance.
* Strong knowledge of contingent workforce compliance, worker classification, and contractual governance.
* Experience managing workforce spend, rate cards, supplier commercials, and program budgets.
* Strong analytical, reporting, and stakeholder\-management capabilities.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and problem\-solving skills.








**Preferred Qualifications** 



* Experience working within a Fortune 500 company, global MNC, or large enterprise environment.
* Experience managing multi\-location or global contingent workforce programs.
* Exposure to Direct Sourcing, Independent Contractor Compliance, and SOW management.
* Experience implementing or transforming MSP/VMS programs.
* Familiarity with Total Talent Management and workforce planning.
* Experience using Power BI, Tableau, Excel, or similar reporting tools.
* Understanding of AI\-enabled workforce management and recruitment automation.








**Key Leadership Competencies** 



* Strategic workforce planning
* Supplier relationship management
* Strong commercial and financial acumen
* Cross\-functional stakeholder engagement
* Data\-driven decision\-making
* Risk management and compliance
* Program governance and operational excellence
* Change management and process transformation








**Why This Opportunity?** 



* Manage a strategic contingent workforce program for a Fortune 500 organization.
* Work with global stakeholders and enterprise workforce management teams.
* Gain exposure to large\-scale MSP, VMS, and Total Talent initiatives.
* Drive workforce transformation through AI, automation, and advanced analytics.
* Contribute to enterprise\-wide workforce efficiency, compliance, and cost optimization.

title: Planning Manager
description:
**About the role** 




  





 The Planning Manager will be responsible for developing, monitoring, and controlling project schedules across all interior design\-and\-build projects. The role requires close coordination with design, procurement, project execution, vendors, and client stakeholders to ensure project milestones are achieved efficiently.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**1\. Project Planning \& Scheduling** 




  




* Own and publish comprehensive baseline project schedules for all active design\-and\-build projects, covering design, procurement, execution, and handover phases.
* Develop detailed, activity\-level schedules that clearly identify critical path, dependencies, and float.
* Build master schedules and rolling look\-ahead plans that surface risks and constraints weeks in advance, enabling proactive recovery.
* Maintain and update all schedules as actuals roll in, keeping them alive and credible as the project's source of truth.



  





**2\. Schedule Monitoring \& Control** 




  




* Track actual progress against planned schedules on a weekly basis; flag delays, acceleration, and deviations immediately.
* Conduct detailed variance analysis, dig into the why behind every slip: is it design approval, procurement, execution, or resource constraints?
* Produce weekly project status reports and monthly scheduling reviews for management; articulate impact on project delivery dates and cost implications.
* Ensure zero misses on timelines, hold the line on milestones and escalate deviations that threaten delivery.



  





**3\. Risk \& Recovery Management** 




  




* Proactively identify schedule\-related risks, design delays, vendor lead times, resource constraints, site conditions, and develop clear mitigation strategies.
* Monitor inter\-dependencies between projects and functions to flag conflicts and resource contention early.



  





**4\. Cross\-Functional Coordination** 




  




* Partner closely with Design, Procurement, Execution, and Site teams to understand realistic timelines, identify bottlenecks, and drive schedule alignment.
* Facilitate monthly planning review meetings and weekly progress tracking calls; be the voice for timeline realism and early warning.
* Work with vendors, subcontractors, and suppliers to understand delivery windows and manage external dependencies.
* Support client communication on project timelines, change impact, and schedule recovery plans.



  





**5\. Planning Tools \& Analytics** 




  




* Maintain accurate project records, schedule baselines, change logs, ensuring data integrity and traceability.
* Spot trends and anomalies: unusual delays, recurring bottlenecks, missed forecasts, and bring structured recommendations to close them.



  





**Academic \& Professional Qualifications** 




  




* Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Architecture, Construction Management, Project Management, or a related field.
* PMP, PRINCE2, or Project Planning certifications are a strong advantage.



  





**Experience** 




  




* 6\-10 years of hands\-on experience in project planning, scheduling, and project controls, not just project support.
* Demonstrated experience managing multiple complex projects simultaneously in design\-and\-build, commercial interiors or workplace fit\-outs.
* Prior exposure to investor\-facing or stakeholder reporting roles is valued.



  





**Technical Skills** 




  




* Deep, confident command of MS Project.
* Advanced proficiency in MS Excel, dashboards, pivot analysis, data visualization, and dynamic reporting.
* Experience building project dashboards in Power BI, Tableau, or equivalent is a strong differentiator.
* Familiarity with construction methodologies, interior fit\-out processes, and project lifecycle management.

title: Recruitment Manager
description:
**ABOUT THE ROLE** 




 We're looking for a Recruitment Manager to take full ownership of day\-to\-day delivery. You'll lead our team leaders and recruiting team, run daily operations, manage client delivery, and make sure mandates convert into closures. This is a hands\-on role. You'll screen, guide and personally close senior mandates, not just supervise.
 



  





**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** 




**Team leadership and performance** 



* Lead the team leaders and recruiters: set daily and weekly targets for sourcing, submissions, interviews and closures.
* Track individual and team performance, spot gaps early, and coach, correct or escalate as needed.
* Run daily team operations: mandate allocation, prioritisation, and resolving day\-to\-day queries and blockers.
* Ensure every new mandate gets a first client submission within 48 hours of receipt.



  





**JD understanding and mandate briefing** 



* Break down client JDs into must\-haves, good\-to\-haves and deal\-breakers before sourcing starts.
* Brief the team on each mandate and review early submissions to correct misalignment quickly.



  





**2nd\-level screening and submissions** 



* Conduct or oversee L2 screening, personally handling senior and leadership roles.
* Ensure only quality\-checked profiles reach clients, with accurate candidate summaries and flagged gaps.



  





**Leadership hiring** 



* Personally handle department\-head, manager and senior mandates, including search, assessment, compensation discussions and closure.
* Manage offer negotiation and pre\-joining engagement to reduce dropouts.



  





**Client engagement** 



* Be the delivery point of contact for clients: requirement calls, feedback follow\-ups, interview coordination and escalations.
* Build client trust through fast TAT and relevant submissions.



  





**Reporting** 



* Own daily and weekly client reports and internal MIS: pipeline, submissions, interviews and closures.
* Keep ATS data accurate and current across the team.
* Share a weekly delivery review with the founder.



  





**REQUIREMENTS** 



* 5\+ years in recruitment, with a significant portion at a recruitment agency or consulting firm. Corporate\-only HR/TA backgrounds will not be considered.
* Proven experience leading a team of 5\+ recruiters, or managing team leads, with measurable delivery outcomes.
* Demonstrated closures of leadership or senior roles, with examples you can walk us through.
* Strong JD\-analysis and screening judgement, going beyond keyword matching.
* Hands\-on with Naukri Resdex, LinkedIn sourcing, and at least one ATS.
* Comfortable with Excel/Google Sheets for reporting.
* Clear, confident communication with senior candidates and client stakeholders.



  





**REMOTE WORK REQUIREMENTS** 



* Own laptop, reliable high\-speed internet and power backup.
* Available during business hours \[confirm days/timings], and responsive on calls and team chat.
* Comfortable with daily output tracking and reporting.



  





**WHAT WE OFFER** 



* Fixed pay plus uncapped closure\-based incentives.
* Full ownership of delivery, working directly with the founder.
* Fully remote role.

title: Director, APAC CISO
description:
The Director provides regional coverage for Asia and Middle East located businesses across three high level functions: (i) Business Support; (ii) Local Governance; (iii) Regulatory Controls. Justification for the backfill focuses on Business Support and Local Governance, as coverage for Regulatory Controls will be delivered from Cyber Posture and Assurance.
   

  

**Business Support**
* The Director role is required to provide a senior touch point for regional business stakeholders and regional technology leadership to discuss Cyber Security Issues and Strategy.
* The role acts as the principal in time\-zone escalation point for operational matters requiring prompt advice and guidance, including providing coverage on Incidents (including 3rd Party).
* The Director role also takes the lead on all regionally driven NAPA engagements across both Asia and Middle East, working directly with the business project teams to understand plans, and guide on Cyber relevant matters. This often requires facilitation with other parts of the CISO organisation to help land on appropriate strategy and outcomes that deliver pragmatic outcomes for the regional business.
* The Director role assists the regional franchise with local internal audits that have Cyber scope, as well as external audits (typically branch level statutory audits).
* The Director provides oversight of regionally relevant and specific risks and issues, owning management and governance of the issues.
* The Director owns coverage of any local control requirements (country specific and localized).
* The Director owns the execution of colleague engagement activities in the region, ensuring reach of key messages and execution of in person events across the multiple regional business sites. This includes attending non\-cyber departmental meetings to present on Cyber themes and topics.


**Local Governance**
* The CISO function is required to provide and present materials representing Cyber risk and Cyber strategy at the many country level governance meetings that operate across APAC and Middle East. The Director is accountable for ensuring these materials provide an accurate and context appropriate view for each of the individual entities that operate. This requires analysis and preparation of materials, derived from globally supplied information and metrics.
* The CISO function are also required to support local governance activities to demonstrate appropriate in branch accountability of operations and decisions. For example Outsourcing – the regional Director is accountable for reviewing all outsourcing decisions from a Cyber Security perspective (goes beyond TPSecM coverage).


**Locations Covered:** 
*Australia, Beijing, Hong Kong, India (BBPLC \& 3 PBWM entities), Israel, Japan, Qatar, Saudi Arabia, Shanghai, Singapore, South Africa, Taiwan, Turkey, United Arab Emirates.*
**Purpose of the role**
 To provide a primary liaison service between the business, technology, and security functions. In order to ensure the confidentiality, integrity and availability of information, and support the mitigation of security risk.
   

  

**Accountabilities**
* Collaboration with stakeholders to understand their security requirements in business processes and IT projects, to enhance overall risk management.
* Execution of risk assessments to identify and prioritise potential cybersecurity threats that could impact the banks operations and data and guide the implementation of mitigation strategies and communicate findings to relevant findings to relevant senior stakeholders.
* Collaboration with business units to develop and implement security policies and procedures for the banks operations aligned to the risk management framework.
* Management of the implementation, testing and monitoring of security controls across the banks IT systems to ensure the effectiveness of controls and mitigation of risk.
* Execution of training content and sessions to educate employees, enhance cybersecurity awareness and provide guidance on safe online practices.
* Management of complex cybersecurity incidents by collaborating with IT teams and response experts to effectively resolve cases through analysis, expertise support and project supervision.
* Identification of emerging cybersecurity trends, threats, and new technologies to address potential risks by advocating the adoption of new security solutions.


**Director Expectations**
* To manage a business function, providing significant input to function wide strategic initiatives. Contribute to and influence policy and procedures for the function and plan, manage and consult on multiple complex and critical strategic projects, which may be business wide..
* They manage the direction of a large team or sub\-function, leading other people managers and embedding a performance culture aligned to the values of the business. Or for an individual contributor, they lead organisation wide projects and act as deep technical expert and thought leader, identifying new ways of working and collaborating cross functionally. They will train, guide and coach less experienced specialists and provide information affecting long term profits, organisational risks and strategic decisions..
* Provide expert advice to senior functional management and committees to influence decisions made outside of own function, offering significant input to function wide strategic initiatives.
* Manage, coordinate and enable resourcing, budgeting and policy creation for a significant sub\-function.
* Escalates breaches of policies / procedure appropriately.
* Foster and guide compliance, ensure regulations are observed that relevant processes in place to facilitate adherence.
* Focus on the external environment, regulators, or advocacy groups to both monitor and influence on behalf of Barclays, when appropriate.
* Demonstrate extensive knowledge of how the function integrates with the business division / Group to achieve the overall business objectives.
* Maintain broad and comprehensive knowledge of industry theories and practices within own discipline alongside up\-to\-date relevant sector / functional knowledge, and insight into external market developments / initiatives.
* Use interpretative thinking and advanced analytical skills to solve problems and design solutions in often complex/ sensitive situations.
* Exercise management authority to make significant decisions and certain strategic decisions or recommendations within own area.
* Negotiate with and influence stakeholders at a senior level both internally and externally.
* Act as principal contact point for key clients and counterparts in other functions/ businesses divisions.
* Mandated as a spokesperson for the function and business division.


 All Senior Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
   

  

 All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

title: AI Delivery & Operations Manager
description:
The AI Delivery \& Operations Manager is responsible for ensuring the successful operational delivery, governance, and support of the organization's AI and Intelligent Demand (iD) capabilities. This role serves as the operational backbone of the AI \& Analytics function, driving agile delivery processes, managing AI use case intake and reviews, coordinating incident response, overseeing platform administration, and ensuring compliance and operational readiness across AI solutions.
   

  

 Working closely with D\&A Product Owners, IT Infrastructure, Security, Compliance, and Development teams, the AI Delivery \& Operations Manager ensures priorities are executed efficiently, risks are identified early, and AI services remain secure, compliant, scalable, and business\-focused.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
  

**Agile Delivery \& Scrum Management**
 Act as the Scrum Manager for both AI and Intelligent Demand (iD) portfolios, ensuring effective planning, prioritization, and execution of work.
   

  

 Responsibilities
   

* Own and manage the AI and iD Jira backlogs, ensuring work items are accurately documented and maintained.
* Facilitate sprint planning, backlog refinement, sprint reviews, and retrospectives.
* Ensure development priorities align with Product Owner objectives and business value.
* Validate that user stories, acceptance criteria, dependencies, and business requirements are sufficiently defined before entering development.
* Monitor sprint progress and proactively identify risks, blockers, and resource constraints.
* Escalate delivery issues, competing priorities, and risks to the Sr. Director of Analytics \& AI (AI Chief Product Owner) as appropriate.
* Drive continuous improvement of agile delivery processes and team effectiveness.


  

**AI Use Case Intake, Review \& Governance**
 Own the operational management of the AI use case review process from intake through approval.
   

  

 Responsibilities
   

* Serve as the primary coordinator for AI use case submissions across the organization.
* Review proposed use cases for business value, strategic alignment, and expected ROI.
* Conduct preliminary technical feasibility assessments in partnership with AI technical delivery teams.
* Provide recommendations regarding prioritization, solution approach, and implementation readiness.
* Coordinate required compliance, security, and AI governance reviews.
* Track approval status and ensure reviews are completed within agreed service levels.
* Maintain visibility of the AI use case pipeline and provide reporting to leadership.
* Ensure approved use cases have appropriate business sponsorship, success metrics, and implementation plans.


  

**Incident Management \& Operational Excellence**
 Ensure reliable operation of AI and analytics platforms through structured incident response and operational governance.
   

  

 Responsibilities
   

* Coordinate real\-time response to production incidents, service disruptions, and critical support issues.
* Ensure appropriate troubleshooting, investigation, and escalation paths are followed.
* Act as the operational point of coordination between business, technical, and support teams during incidents.
* Drive post\-incident reviews and Root Cause Analysis (RCA) activities.
* Ensure corrective and preventive actions are documented, assigned, and tracked to completion.
* Establish operational standards, monitoring procedures, and service management practices.
* Maintain incident records, operational metrics, and service health reporting.


  

**AI Platform Administration \& Access Management**
 Own operational oversight of AI platform administration and user enablement.
   

  

 Responsibilities
   

* Manage the interface with IT Infrastructure team regarding AI platform access \& operations.
* Coordinate GenAI licensing requests, provisioning, renewals, and utilization tracking.
* Oversee access management processes for AI platforms, applications, and environments.
* Ensure appropriate controls exist for user onboarding, role assignments, and offboarding.
* Support audits and compliance reviews related to AI platform access and usage.
* Monitor platform adoption and identify opportunities for operational optimization.


  

**Process, Dependency \& Governance Management**
 Ensure operational processes, dependencies, and delivery assets are maintained and consistently applied.
   

  

 Responsibilities
   

* Maintain centralized repositories for technical dependencies, implementation checklists, governance requirements, and operational documentation.
* Ensure delivery teams follow established development, deployment, compliance, and release management processes.
* Coordinate cross\-functional dependencies between product, engineering, infrastructure, security, and business teams.
* Identify operational risks and implement mitigation plans.
* Establish and maintain standard operating procedures (SOPs) for AI and analytics operations.
* Support internal audits, governance reviews, and leadership reporting requirements.


  

**Key Stakeholder Relationships**
* D\&A Leadership
* D\&A Product Owners
* AI \& Analytics Development Teams
* Business Sponsors
* IT Infrastructure \& Security Team
* Compliance Functions
* Other D\&A and IT Support Teams


  

**Qualifications \& Experience**
  

 Required

title: General Manager/Assistant General Manager - Resort Management at Manori
description:
Role Overview: The General Manager (GM) is responsible for end\-to\-end management of the resort, including administration, day\-to\-day operations, legal and statutory compliance, guest experience, and business growth. The GM will work closely with the owners/management to execute innovative ideas that enhance revenue, profitability, and brand positioning of the resort. Key Responsibilities: 1\. Overall Resort Administration. Lead and manage all departments: Front Office, Housekeeping, F\&B, Kitchen, Spa/Activities, Security, Engineering, Finance, HR and Stores.
 


* Develop and implement SOPs for all operational areas to ensure consistency, efficiency and high service standards.
* Set annual and monthly operational targets and monitor performance against KPIs (occupancy, ADR, RevPAR, guest satisfaction, costs, etc.).



  





 2\. Day\-to\-Day OperationsOversee daily operations to ensure smooth functioning of the resort across all shifts.
 


* Resolve operational bottlenecks quickly and maintain high standards of cleanliness, safety, and guest service.
* Conduct daily/weekly departmental review meetings and ensure coordination between teams.
* Monitor procurement, inventory and cost control for food, beverages, linens, amenities and other supplies.



  





 3\. Legal, Licensing and Statutory ComplianceEnsure all licenses and registrations (hospitality, FSSAI, liquor, local tourism, pollution control, fire safety, music/entertainment, etc.) are valid, renewed on time and properly documented.
 


* Ensure compliance with local, state and national laws related to labour, wages, ESI, PF, safety and environmental norms.
* Coordinate with legal advisors, chartered accountants and company secretaries to maintain statutory records and filings.
* Handle inspections, audits and visits from government or regulatory authorities, ensuring full cooperation and zero non\-compliance.



  





 4\. Financial Management and ProfitabilityPrepare and manage annual budgets, forecasts and monthly MIS reports in coordination with Finance.
 


* Track revenue streams (rooms, F\&B, banquets, events, activities, spa, ancillary services) and drive strategies to increase yield and profitability.
* Implement cost\-control measures without compromising guest experience and brand standards.
* Review P\&L statements regularly and recommend corrective actions to management.



  





 5\. Revenue Growth, Sales \& Marketing SupportCollaborate with the sales and marketing team/agency on room packages, events, retreats, weddings, conferences and other offerings to boost occupancy and average rates.
 


* Support digital marketing and OTA strategies (website, social media, Google, booking portals) by providing inputs on promotions, guest stories, visual content and campaigns.
* Build and maintain relationships with travel agents, corporates, event planners and local partners to drive business.

 6\. Innovation, Business Renovation \& Brand BuildingWork with management to identify and execute innovative, creative ideas to upgrade the resort’s product, services and experiences (e.g., themed experiences, wellness retreats, eco\-friendly initiatives, local cultural programs).
 


* Plan and oversee renovation, refurbishment and modernization projects in coordination with architects, vendors and contractors.

* 7\. Guest Experience and Service QualityEnsure a guest\-centric culture in the resort, with consistent, warm and professional service.

 8\. People Leadership \& CultureLead by example and build a high\-performance, accountable, and collaborative culture in the resort.

 9\. Safety, Security and Risk ManagementEnsure implementation of health, safety and hygiene protocols across the property.
 


* Oversee security arrangements for guests, staff and property assets.
* Develop and periodically review emergency and crisis management plans (fire, medical emergencies, natural disasters, etc.).

 10\. Reporting and Stakeholder ManagementProvide regular updates to promoters/owners on operations, financials, projects and risk areas.

title: Demand Planning and Supply Chain Lead
description:
**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**1\. Procurement Management** 



* Take over manufacturer/vendor coordination after NPD finalizes the product, costing, and first product details.
* Release purchase orders and maintain accurate PO trackers.
* Coordinate with vendors for production timelines, dispatch timelines, quantities, and delivery commitments.
* Manage repeat orders and future PO processing based on inventory requirements.
* Coordinate on MOQ, delivery timelines, payment terms, and commercial terms where required.
* Track vendor\-wise lead times, production capacity, and delivery adherence.
* Escalate vendor delays, short supply, quality issues, cost changes, or documentation gaps on time.
* Work with Finance for payment planning and working capital alignment.



**2\. Inventory Planning** 



* Maintain SKU\-wise and platform\-wise inventory plans across brands and channels.
* Track current stock, in\-transit stock, platform stock, 3PL stock, blocked stock, and available stock.
* Monitor inventory days at SKU, brand, platform, and company level.
* Maintain target inventory days around 60 days, adjusted by SKU type, lead time, MOQ, sales velocity, and campaign plans.
* Track 7\-day, 15\-day, and 30\-day average sales velocity for important SKUs.
* Predict expected stockout dates and raise reorder alerts before risk becomes urgent.
* Prepare reorder plans based on sales velocity, lead time, safety stock, vendor timelines, and platform inward timelines.
* Identify excess stock, slow\-moving stock, dead stock, and inventory above 60/90 days.
* Prepare purchase priority lists based on sales, margin, stockout risk, campaign importance, and cash flow.



**3\. Fulfilment \& Platform Delivery** 



* Plan timely pickup of stock from manufacturers/vendors.
* Coordinate with transporters, 3PLs, platform teams, and internal stakeholders.
* Ensure stock reaches the correct warehouse, 3PL, or platform on time.
* Manage Amazon, Flipkart, Quick Commerce, D2C, MT, GT, and other platform replenishment requirements.
* Own appointment booking and appointment follow\-ups for platform deliveries.
* Track dispatch date, delivery date, GRN/inward date, and live stock date.
* Ensure stock is not only dispatched but also inwarded and available for sale.
* Track delayed appointments, rejected shipments, short deliveries, damaged deliveries, and pending GRNs.
* Coordinate inter\-warehouse stock transfers where required.



**4\. NPD to Supply Chain Handover** 




 The Supply Chain Lead must ensure that every new product handover includes: 
 


* Final vendor/manufacturer details, final approved costing, MOQ, lead time, payment terms, and production timeline.
* Final product specifications, packaging specifications, product dimensions, weight, barcode/MRP, and batch details.
* Shelf life and expiry details wherever applicable.
* QC checklist, first PO recommendation, expected launch date, initial inventory requirement, and platform\-wise launch stock plan.
* No PO should be released unless the NPD handover is complete.



  





**Ideal Candidate Profile** 




 The ideal candidate should not be only a procurement person or only a dispatch coordinator. This person should understand the full supply chain cycle and be able to connect vendor timelines, inventory days, platform stock, appointments, cash flow, and sales impact. 
 



**The person should think like a planner, execute like an operator, and follow up like an owner.**

title: Manager, Supply Chain
description:
Woodward is the global leader in the design, manufacturing, and service of energy conversion and control solutions for the aerospace and industrial equipment markets. Together with our customers, we are enabling the path to a cleaner, decarbonized world. Our innovative fluid, combustion, electrical, propulsion and motion control systems perform in some of the world’s harshest environments.
   

  

 At Woodward we have created a culture that appreciates and values the contributions of every member. We are a global team of curious, innovative problem\-solvers who commit our knowledge, resources and technical expertise to the challenges associated with reducing emissions, enabling alternative energy sources and increasing efficiency, always innovating for a better future.
   

  

 We are committed to creating a great workplace for all team members. Our company and its members are committed to acting with integrity, being respectful and accountable to one another, and staying humble and driven, while maintaining the highest professional and ethical standards.
   

  

 We are steadfastly committed to attracting the best talent across our communities, creating a rewarding workplace. Together we are fulfilling our purpose to design and deliver energy control solutions our partners count on to power a clean future.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities:**
* Strategic Planning: Develop and implement comprehensive supply chain strategies to enhance efficiency, reduce costs, and align with the company's overall objectives.
* Supplier Management: Establish and maintain relationships with suppliers to ensure the quality, reliability, and timely delivery of materials and services.
* Cross\-Functional Collaboration: Collaborate with others across functions to ensure seamless supply chain integration and alignment.
* Performance Monitoring and Improvement: Analyze supply chain performance metrics, identify areas for improvement, and implement initiatives to enhance productivity and effectiveness.
* Team Leadership: Lead, mentor, and develop the supply chain team to achieve high performance, foster professional growth, and meet organizational goals.


**Key Skills:**
* Strategic Planning. A Manager, Supply Chain at the M2 level effectively develops and implements long term strategies to optimize the supply chain, ensuring alignment with the company's overall business goals.

* Leadership. Strong leadership skills are essential to guide and motivate the supply chain team, fostering a collaborative environment and driving performance towards meeting organizational objectives.
* Data Analysis. The ability to analyze complex data sets is crucial for making informed decisions, identifying trends, and improving supply chain processes through data driven insights.

title: RCM Associate Manager - Quality
description:
**Job Description Summary**
 The Associate Manager – Quality, RCM is responsible for leading, monitoring, and continuously improving the quality assurance function within Revenue Cycle Management operations. This is a people\-plus\-process leadership role that combines hands\-on audit governance with team management, client engagement, and strategic quality improvement.
   

  

 You will serve as the primary quality ambassador between operations, clients, and senior leadership — ensuring compliance with payer guidelines, HIPAA regulations, and internal SOPs while driving performance excellence across all QA analysts. You will own the quality scorecard, shape audit strategy, and build a culture of accountability and continuous learning within your team.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Quality Oversight \& Governance**
* Own and enforce quality benchmarks across all RCM functions — coding, billing, AR follow\-up, denial management, and payment posting
* Establish and maintain quality control checkpoints at each stage of the revenue cycle workflow
* Ensure 100% alignment with CMS guidelines, payer\-specific rules, client contractual obligations, and HIPAA/PHI regulations
* Define and manage the monthly/quarterly audit plan, sampling strategies, and QA frameworks


**Audit Management \& Root Cause Analysis**
* Oversee daily, weekly, and monthly transaction audits and calibration sessions across all RCM verticals
* Drive root cause analysis (RCA) for all identified errors and ensure actionable corrective plans are documented and tracked
* Maintain comprehensive audit trails and error logs for regulatory and client review
* Identify recurring defect patterns and escalate critical findings to operations leadership with data\-backed reports


**Team Leadership \& People Management**
* Lead, mentor, coach, and manage a team of 20\+ QA analysts, ensuring equitable workload distribution and professional growth
* Facilitate regular team huddles, one\-on\-one feedback sessions, and calibration meetings to promote a quality\-first culture
* Identify skill gaps through error trend analysis and develop targeted coaching and upskilling plans
* Act as the first point of escalation for QA analysts and provide real\-time guidance and support
* Participate in monthly/quarterly performance reviews for all QA team members in coordination with HR


**Performance Management \& Analytics**
* Track, analyze, and report quality metrics including accuracy rates, defect rates, rework rates, and SLA adherence
* Manage and implement corrective action plans (CAPs) for underperforming analysts and processes
* Align team KPIs with organizational quality goals and report progress to senior leadership
* Monitor Cost of Poor Quality (COPQ) and drive year\-on\-year reduction targets


**Process Improvement \& Innovation**
* Drive continuous improvement (CI) initiatives to reduce defects, rework, and COPQ using Lean/Six Sigma methodologies
* Design and optimize QA workflows, sampling strategies, and feedback loop mechanisms
* Collaborate with operations, IT, and training teams to implement process changes that improve first\-pass accuracy rates
* Evaluate and pilot quality improvement technologies (e.g., AI\-powered auditing tools, automation)


**Client Engagement \& Stakeholder Management**
* Lead and participate in client quality calls, review meetings, and audits — presenting quality metrics, trends, and action plans
* Manage and resolve client escalations related to quality issues within defined SLAs
* Support client\-specific onboarding by documenting payer rules, quality requirements, and SOPs
* Build and maintain strong client relationships by ensuring consistent delivery of quality benchmarks


**Reporting, Documentation \& Compliance**
* Prepare and share daily/weekly/monthly quality MIS reports, scorecards, and dashboards with leadership
* Maintain up\-to\-date QA SOPs, error category definitions, calibration logs, and feedback templates
* Design and deliver quality\-related training modules for new joiners and refresher programs for existing staff
* Stay current with payer policy changes and disseminate relevant updates to the quality and operations teams


**What We’re Looking For**
**Education \& Experience**
* Graduate in any discipline; additional certification in Medical Billing / Coding (CPC, CRC, CPMA) preferable
* 9 \- 11 years of experience in RCM operations with a minimum of 7 years in a Quality Analyst / Senior QA / Team Lead role
* Proven track record of managing quality teams of 10\+ members in a healthcare BPO/KPO environment


**Domain Expertise**
* In\-depth knowledge of Billing , payment posting AR follow\-up, denial management, and payer rules
* Strong understanding of HIPAA, PHI, CMS guidelines, and payer\-specific compliance requirements
* Experience with EMR/PMS systems) and QA dashboards
* Proficiency in MS Excel (advanced), data analysis, and MIS/dashboard reporting
* Familiarity with Lean/Six Sigma methodologies or process improvement frameworks is a strong plus


**Leadership \& Soft Skills**
* Demonstrated ability to lead, mentor, and drive performance improvements across teams
* Excellent written and verbal communication for client interactions, presentations, and internal reporting
* Strong analytical thinking, problem\-solving ability, and attention to detail
* Ability to manage multiple priorities, meet tight deadlines, and thrive in a fast\-paced environment
* Effective stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence without authority


 Compensation for this job is subject to market conditions, geographic considerations, the candidate’s unique skills and experience, state and local laws, and budget. Our commitment to pay transparency is a testament to our dedication to creating a fair, equitable, and inclusive workplace. By continuously analyzing market trends, staying abreast of changes in state laws, and making budgetary adjustments accordingly, we strive to ensure that our compensation practices reflect the value we place on our associates’ unique contributions and support their professional growth.
   

  

**Enhancing Lives and Building Careers**
 Veradigm believes in empowering our associates with the tools and flexibility to bring the best version of themselves to work and to further their professional development. Together, we are In the Network. Interested in learning more?
   

  

 Take a look at our Culture, Benefits, Early Talent Program, and Additional Openings.
   

  

 Visa Sponsorship is not offered for this position.
   

  

 At Veradigm, our greatest strength comes from bringing together talented people with diverse perspectives to support the needs of healthcare providers, life science companies, health plans, and the patients they serve. The Veradigm Network is a dynamic, open community of solutions, external partners, and cutting\-edge artificial intelligence technologies that provide advanced insights, technology, and data\-driven solutions. Veradigm offers a comprehensive compensation and benefits package, including holidays, vacation, medical, dental, and vision insurance, company paid life insurance and retirement savings.
   

  

 Veradigm’s policy is to provide equal employment opportunity and affirmative action in all of its employment practices without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, ancestry, marital status, protected veteran status, age, individuals with disabilities, sexual orientation or gender identity or expression or any other legally protected category. Applicants for North American based positions with Veradigm must be legally authorized to work in the United States or Canada. Verification of employment eligibility will be required as a condition of hire. title: Sr Lead, Anaplan solutions & planning platforms Pune/ Bangalore
description:
**About Northern Trust**
 As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.
   

  

 Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.
   

  

 With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.
   

  

**Senior Lead, Anaplan Solutions \& Planning Platforms** 
  

  

*Job Description \| Finance Technology*
**Position Summary** 
  

  

 We are seeking an experienced and highly motivated
 **Senior Lead, Anaplan Solutions \& Planning Platforms** 
 to lead the implementation, support, and strategic expansion of enterprise planning solutions across Finance. This role will own delivery outcomes across Anaplan Staff Planning, Forecasting, CCAR support, Income Statement planning, Data Hub architecture, integrations, UX reporting, and future planning modernization capabilities.
   

  

 The ideal candidate is not only a strong Anaplan expert, but also a capability builder who can establish delivery discipline, mentor a team, strengthen governance, and translate business priorities into scalable, controlled, and user\-friendly planning solutions.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities** 
  

  

* Required Technical Skills \& Experience
* Deep expertise in Anaplan solution architecture, model building, Data Hub design, ALM, UX development, and deployment management, with a proven ability to design scalable, high\-performing enterprise planning solutions.
* Strong functional knowledge of FP\&A, workforce planning, budgeting, forecasting, scenario modeling, and financial data management, with the ability to translate complex business requirements into actionable planning capabilities.
* Experience leading end\-to\-end implementation and enhancement of enterprise planning platforms, including requirements gathering, solution design, development, testing, deployment, governance, and production support.
* Proven ability to design and manage enterprise data integrations, leveraging APIs, SQL, and data analysis techniques to ensure data accuracy, integrity, and timely availability across planning ecosystems.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and troubleshooting skills with expertise in reporting, analytics, controls, access management, documentation, and regulatory compliance requirements.
* Advanced proficiency in Excel and financial modeling, complemented by experience working within Agile delivery frameworks and modern Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) practices.
* Demonstrated ability to lead cross\-functional teams, influence stakeholders, establish best practices, and drive continuous improvement initiatives that enhance planning efficiency, data quality, and business outcomes.
* Leadership \& Team Development
* Build, mentor, and lead a high\-performing Anaplan delivery team comprising model builders, analysts, engineers, and solution SMEs.
* Establish clear ways of working across backlog management, sprint execution, release planning, quality reviews, documentation, and production support.
* Coach team members on Anaplan best practices, model design, data management, performance optimization, and business engagement.
* Create a sustainable capability model with role clarity, cross\-training, succession planning, and measurable skill maturity.
* Strategy, Roadmap \& Stakeholder Management
* Partner with Finance, FP\&A, HR, Risk, Corporate Functions, and Technology stakeholders to define priorities, business outcomes, and delivery roadmap.
* Translate business needs into scalable Anaplan solutions that improve forecasting, workforce planning, scenario analysis, expense planning, and management reporting.
* Act as a trusted advisor to senior stakeholders by providing clear options, risks, dependencies, trade\-offs, and recommendations.
* Lead prioritization forums and drive alignment across business value, regulatory needs, capacity, and technical feasibility.
* Solution Architecture \& Delivery Ownership
* Own end\-to\-end design and delivery of enterprise Anaplan capabilities across Staff Planning, Forecasting, CCAR, Income Statement planning, cost center planning, and scenario modeling.
* Design scalable multi\-model architectures using Data Hub, ALM, controlled data flows, modular design principles, and reusable planning components.
* Ensure models are performant, auditable, maintainable, secure, and aligned to Anaplan and enterprise technology standards.
* Oversee requirements, design, build, testing, UAT, deployment, documentation, and post\-production stabilization.
* Platform Operations, Controls \& Data Quality
* Strengthen production support, incident management, release governance, access controls, and operational risk management.
* Establish data validation, reconciliation, completeness checks, and error\-handling processes across inbound and outbound planning data.
* Drive improvements in platform stability, data accuracy, business adoption, user experience, and planning cycle efficiency.
* Maintain strong documentation for model architecture, data lineage, integrations, controls, release records, and support procedures.


  

  

* Innovation \& Continuous Improvement
* Identify opportunities to simplify planning processes, automate manual activities, enhance reporting visibility, and improve self\-service capability.
* Evaluate and apply modern planning practices including predictive planning, advanced analytics, AI\-enabled insights, and integration automation where appropriate.
* Promote a culture of continuous improvement, operational precision, accountability, and business\-value driven delivery.


**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems
* 10\+ years of experience in enterprise planning, financial systems, EPM platforms, FP\&A technology, or related finance technology domains.
* 8\+ years of hands\-on Anaplan implementation, model building, and solution architecture experience.
* Proven experience leading enterprise\-scale planning implementations from concept through production deployment.
* Strong working knowledge of FP\&A, forecasting, budgeting, workforce planning, management reporting, cost center planning, and financial data structures.
* Anaplan Certified Solution Architect or Master Anaplanner credentials preferred.
* Experience with Hyperion, Oracle EPM, OneStream, SAP BPC, Workday, Power BI, SQL, ETL tools, APIs, or enterprise data platforms is good to have
* Experience in banking, financial services, regulatory planning, risk, CCAR, SOX\-controlled environments, or large global enterprises.
* Strong Agile delivery experience and familiarity with SDLC, DevOps, change management, and release governance.
* Experience designing Data Hub architecture, integrations, validation routines, and controlled data flows.
* Demonstrated experience building, mentoring, and leading technical teams.
* Excellent executive communication, stakeholder management, analytical thinking, and problem\-solving skills.


  

  

**Working with Us**
 As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.
   

  

 Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.

title: VP, IAM Assurance Leader (L13)
description:
**Role Title: VP, IAM Assurance Leader (L13\)**
**Company Overview**
 Synchrony (NYSE: SYF) is a premier consumer financial services company delivering one of the industry’s most complete digitally enabled product suites. Our experience, expertise and scale encompass a broad spectrum of industries including digital, health and wellness, retail, telecommunications, home, auto, outdoors, pet and more.
   

  

* We have recently been ranked \#2 among India’s Best Companies to Work for by Great Place to Work. We were among the Top 50 India’s Best Workplaces in Building a Culture of Innovation by All by GPTW and Top 25 among Best Workplaces in BFSI by GPTW. We have also been recognized by AmbitionBox Employee Choice Awards among the Top 20 Mid\-Sized Companies, ranked \#3 among Top Rated Companies for Women, and Top\-Rated Financial Services Companies.
* We provide best\-in\-class employee benefits and programs that cater to work\-life integration and overall well\-being.
* We provide career advancement and upskilling opportunities for all to take up leadership roles.


**Organizational Overview**
 The Identity and Access Management (IAM) team at Synchrony oversees key security functions including authentication, authorization, privileged access management, special programs, and federated controls governance. This team ensures comprehensive management of identity and access processes to maintain robust security and compliance across the organization. This role will oversee a team of seven and be a direct report into the VP, IAM Programs Leader.
   

  

**Role Summary/Purpose**
 We are seeking an innovative and results\-driven leader to serve as VP, IAM Assurance Leader, responsible for leading the IAM Services Assurance function overseeing key controls across all centralized and decentralized IAM services. This role will work closely with IAM product owners and engineering teams to ensure adherence to Synchrony IAM standards and regulatory requirements without disrupting operational delivery.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will possess deep technical expertise and hands\-on experience across IAM controls, assurance operations, and identity/authentication platforms (e.g., Active Directory, LDAP technologies, Beyond Identity, and related IAM services). As a strategic leader, you will guide teams, enable cross\-functional collaboration, and drive continuous improvement in the effectiveness, reporting, and automation of IAM controls—particularly in critical areas such as logical access, authentication assurance, privileged access oversight, and control evidence for SOX/PCI and other regulatory obligations. You will blend technology insight with program management discipline to ensure success in execution and delivery, including the creation and modernization of assurance reporting capabilities and the automation of control remediation where appropriate.
   

  

**Essential Responsibilities**
* Create and Maintain Strategic Roadmaps: Develop and execute multi\-year roadmaps to drive innovation, strengthen security posture, meet regulatory requirements, and streamline IAM operations—specifically for IAM assurance capabilities, control monitoring, and evidence automation.
* Stakeholder Engagement: Build and nurture strong relationships across Security Operations, Technology Teams, Governance, Operational Risk, and Internal Audit, ensuring program alignment, audit readiness, and the ability to clearly demonstrate IAM control effectiveness to stakeholders and regulators.
* Risk and Progress Management: Identify, assess, and mitigate technical and organizational risks while regularly reporting blockers, corrective actions, and program milestones to executive leadership; ensure timely remediation of control gaps and recurring defects.
* Solution Design \& Automation: Lead and contribute to designing technical solutions for complex automation use cases, driving operational efficiency and scalability—especially automation to detect, track, and remediate IAM control defects.
* Program Integrity: Ensure standards, policies, and procedures are accurately documented and officially maintained for audit and compliance requirements; recommend updates to IAM standards based on security threats, regulatory expectations, and industry trends.
* Performance Tracking: Define, implement, and monitor Key Risk Indicators (KRIs) and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) to measure program maturity and overall effectiveness, including assurance coverage, control pass rates, remediation SLAs, defect recurrence, and reporting timeliness/accuracy.
* Assurance Operations Leadership: Lead assurance activities to track, validate, and remediate key logical access and authentication controls across centralized IAM services (e.g., Active Directory, Oracle LDAP, Beyond Identity) and decentralized implementations as applicable.
* Assurance Reporting Platform Ownership: Manage and evolve the IAM assurance reporting platform(s) used to monitor adherence to Synchrony standards, control design, and operational effectiveness; ensure reporting is accurate, resilient, and audit\-ready.
* Agile Partnership with Product Owners: Partner with IAM product owners and delivery teams using Agile methodologies to prioritize and implement control improvements, balancing risk reduction with service stability and customer impact.
* Control Evidence \& Audit Support: Ensure the organization can efficiently produce high\-quality evidence for SOX, PCI, and other examinations; proactively address audit issues with root\-cause correction and sustainable control improvements.
* Documentation \& Enablement: Oversee creation, maintenance, and review of operational process documentation and end\-user/training materials needed to support consistent execution of IAM assurance activities.
* Problem Resolution: Independently resolve technical challenges while escalating issues with clarity when necessary.
* Perform other critical duties or special projects as assigned.


**Qualifications/Requirements**
* BS/BA in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Business Management, or equivalent, plus 10\+ years IT experience, OR in lieu of a degree with 12\+ years IT experience demonstrating progressive responsibility.
* Minimum 5 years of experience leading multiple IAM service products (e.g., authentication, privileged access, identity governance) and driving outcomes across both centralized and distributed service models.
* Minimum 5 years of experience developing and improving IAM service processes and reporting on IAM service key controls (design and operating effectiveness).
* Minimum 3 years leading operations or assurance teams, including continuous monitoring, issue management, and control remediation.
* At least 2 years working with Agile methodologies in roles such as Product Owner, Scrum Master, or Technical Lead.
* Minimum 2 years of people management experience, leading teams of 2\+ engineers or contractors.


**Technical Expertise**
* Strong understanding of IAM directory services, such as Active Directory, LDAP, Oracle LDAP, or similar.
* Experience with assurance reporting, control monitoring dashboards, and/or metrics platforms used to track compliance and remediation status.
* Hands\-on experience with Security Control Design and Security Assurance Operations, including defining controls, validating operating effectiveness, and driving remediation.
* Hands\-on experience with Unix/Linux Server Access Administration and access security.
* Experience supporting or integrating IAM platforms and processes such as ServiceNow, SailPoint IdentityIQ, privileged access tooling (e.g., Bomgar/BeyondTrust), and authentication technologies (e.g., RSA Authentication Manager or equivalents).


**Skills**
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills for effective cross\-team collaboration and executive reporting, including the ability to translate technical risk into business impact.
* Strategic thinker able to develop and articulate long\-term program visions and actionable roadmaps.
* Strong organizational and prioritization skills, capable of managing multiple concurrent projects in complex environments.
* Proactive problem solver with the ability to navigate ambiguity and escalate appropriately.
* Strong analytical and clear\-thinking skills; ability to interpret control results, identify root causes, and drive durable corrective actions.
* Customer\-oriented mindset and ability to reduce friction for product teams while improving assurance outcomes.


**Desired Characteristics**
* Proven experience leading large\-scale IAM initiatives, including program design, execution, and cross\-functional collaboration in complex technical environments.
* Exceptional communication and organizational skills, with a track record of creating and executing long\-term strategic roadmaps.
* Strong ability to manage risk and complexity, navigate roadblocks, and drive corrective actions effectively.
* Demonstrated ability to lead, mentor, and manage teams while building partnerships across business units and fostering alignment to organizational goals.
* Strong commitment to providing outstanding customer experiences; ability to balance control compliance with minimal operational disruption.
* Self\-starter with a strong sense of urgency and flexibility to change directions quickly while maintaining delivery discipline.
* Experience with the process of creating, maintaining and reviewing operations process \& end user training documentation.
* Working knowledge of ServiceNow, SailPoint IdentityIQ, Active Directory, Bomgar/BeyondTrust privileged access, Unix LDAP, and RSA Authentication Manager (or comparable tools).
* Experience working in highly regulated industries (Finance, Healthcare, Government), particularly enterprise\-level security in a financial institution.
* Familiarity with compliance standards such as SOX, PCI, FFIEC, GDPR, HIPAA, or NIST cybersecurity frameworks, including NIST 800\-63 and logical access control expectations.
* Certifications such as CISSP, CISM, PMP, or relevant IAM\-focused certifications.


**Eligibility Criteria**
 BS/BA in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Business Management, or equivalent, plus 10\+ years IT experience, OR in lieu of a degree with 12\+ years IT experience demonstrating progressive responsibility.
   

  

**Work Timings** 
 : 9AM \- 5PM EST
   

  

 Role requires collaboration during India and US business hour overlap windows to support leadership and stakeholder discussions.
   

  

**For Internal Applicants**

 The Manager / Divisional Manager \- IT Security \& Governance is responsible for implementing and operating cybersecurity, information security governance, and incident response capabilities across IT and OT environments in a manufacturing setup. The role protects the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of information assets while aligning security controls with business, regulatory, and compliance requirements.

**Cyber Security \& Incident Response** 



* Own the full cyber security incident response lifecycle: detection, containment, eradication, recovery, and post\-incident review.
* Develop and maintain incident response plans, playbooks, and runbooks.
* Coordinate incident response with SOC, IT, OT, legal, risk, and business stakeholders.
* Conduct tabletop exercises and simulations to test cyber resilience.



**Security Operations Center (SOC)** 



* Oversee in\-house or managed SOC operations.
* Ensure effective monitoring of SIEM, EDR, IDS/IPS, and log management platforms.
* Define security use cases, alert thresholds, escalation procedures, and reporting metrics.
* Review SOC performance, KPIs, and incident trends.

* Manage risk assessments, control testing, audit findings, and remediation plans.

* Work with IT and OT teams to design and implement secure architectures.
